key: And what a distasteful word-- "biological"--
en: And what a distasteful word-- "biological"--
ja: それにしても　なんて　いやな言葉かしら――「生物学上の」なんて――

key: I'm sure there are innocuous uses of it yet, but I struggle to associate it with science over personal irritation.
en: I'm sure there are innocuous uses of it yet, but I struggle to associate it with science over personal irritation.
ja: 害のない使い方も　あるのでしょうけれど　わたしには　個人的な不快さが　先に立って　科学と　結びつけるのが　むずかしいの

key: It is always used in cases of trying to assert truths of some matter or another which one cannot truly know.
en: It is always used in cases of trying to assert truths of some matter or another which one cannot truly know.
ja: その言葉は　いつも　本当には　知りようのないことについて　真実を　主張しようとするときに　使われるのよ

key: Nevertheless, I come to doubt the ethics of my ignorance.
en: Nevertheless, I come to doubt the ethics of my ignorance.
ja: それでも　目を背け続けることの　倫理を　疑うようにも　なってきたの

key: Perhaps for the sake of another person, I can demonstrate undeserved tolerance.
en: Perhaps for the sake of another person, I can demonstrate undeserved tolerance.
ja: 誰か　ほかの人のためになら　受けるに値しない寛容さを　示すことも　できるのかもしれない

key: But he will want more from me than I wish to offer him.
en: But he will want more from me than I wish to offer him.
ja: けれど　あの人は　わたしが　差しだしたいと思う以上のものを　求めてくるでしょう

key: Just how far should one go for something like that...
en: Just how far should one go for something like that...
ja: そのようなもののために　人は　どこまで　行くべきなのかしら……

key: Is a parent's duty not to his child?
en: Is a parent's duty not to his child?
ja: 親の務めとは　子に向けられるもの　ではないのか?

key: Then he may demonstrate it, and I will place my limits accordingly.
en: Then he may demonstrate it, and I will place my limits accordingly.
ja: ならば　まずは　それを示してもらおう。わたしは　それに応じて　線を引く

key: LUNA: Well met, \PN!
en: LUNA: Well met, \PN!
ja: ルナ: よくぞ来てくれた　\PN!

key: Tell me, have you seen any place especially lovely on your travels?
en: Tell me, have you seen any place especially lovely on your travels?
ja: ねえ　旅の途中で　とりわけ美しい場所を　見たことは　ある?

key: I would so love to hear!
en: I would so love to hear!
ja: ぜひ　聞かせてほしい!

key: I've seen so many wonderful places, of course, but I am quite sure I can't have seen them all!
en: I've seen so many wonderful places, of course, but I am quite sure I can't have seen them all!
ja: わたしも　すばらしい場所を　たくさん見てきた。でも　そのすべてを　見たわけでは　ないはず!

key: It is a marvelous world out there.
en: It is a marvelous world out there.
ja: 外の世界は　驚きに満ちている

key: And out here, as well.
en: And out here, as well.
ja: そして　この場所も　また同じ

key: LUNA: How do you do?
en: LUNA: How do you do?
ja: ルナ: ごきげんよう

key: LUNA: This dance floor is rather dreamlike in its own way, is it not?
en: LUNA: This dance floor is rather dreamlike in its own way, is it not?
ja: ルナ: このダンスフロアも　これはこれで　夢のよう　だと思わない?

key: It is not to my comfort to partake, but I hardly mind the atmosphere.
en: It is not to my comfort to partake, but I hardly mind the atmosphere.
ja: 加わるのは　わたしの性に合わないけれど　この空気は　嫌いではない

key: LUNA: Unlike some of the others, I have no magic or powers to back me up--
en: LUNA: Unlike some of the others, I have no magic or powers to back me up--
ja: ルナ: ほかの人たちと違って　わたしには　支えとなる魔法も　力もない――

key: None more than any normal person may carry, anyway.
en: None more than any normal person may carry, anyway.
ja: 普通の人が　持っている以上のものは　何ひとつ

key: But then, with courage and an adventurous spirit, that may yet be a lot more magic than many might assume.
en: But then, with courage and an adventurous spirit, that may yet be a lot more magic than many might assume.
ja: けれど　勇気と　冒険心があれば　それは　多くの人が思うより　ずっと大きな魔法に　なるのかもしれない

key: LUNA: It is ever kind of you to continue policing this place as such.
en: LUNA: It is ever kind of you to continue policing this place as such.
ja: ルナ: この場所を　こうして見守り続けてくれる　あなたの優しさに　いつも感謝している

key: May your strength be as unfaltering as your resilience.
en: May your strength be as unfaltering as your resilience.
ja: あなたの強さが　その粘り強さと同じくらい　揺るがぬもので　ありますように

key: SAMSON: Hi.
en: SAMSON: Hi.
ja: サムソン: よう

key: Glad you made it back.
en: Glad you made it back.
ja: よく戻ってきたな

key: I wanted to say sorry for back there.
en: I wanted to say sorry for back there.
ja: あのときのことを　謝りたかったんだ

key: I don't remember everything that happened back there... but I've been getting bits and pieces.
en: I don't remember everything that happened back there... but I've been getting bits and pieces.
ja: あそこで何があったか　全部は覚えてない……けど　少しずつ　思い出してきててな

key: Remembered enough to know I need to apologize.
en: Remembered enough to know I need to apologize.
ja: 謝らなきゃいけないってことが　分かるくらいには　思い出した

key: If you and the Boss hadn't found me there...
en: If you and the Boss hadn't found me there...
ja: オマエとボスが　あそこでオレを　見つけてくれなかったら……

key: Well. Thanks.
en: Well. Thanks.
ja: まあ……ありがとな

key: Glad you finally made it back.
en: Glad you finally made it back.
ja: やっと戻ってきたか。よかったよ

key: People've been pretty worried.
en: People've been pretty worried.
ja: みんな　かなり心配してたぜ

key: Soon as I got here, that Julia girl came over, and--
en: Soon as I got here, that Julia girl came over, and--
ja: オレがここに着くなり　ジュリアってお嬢さんが　寄ってきてな――

key: Well, I guess you know how she is.
en: Well, I guess you know how she is.
ja: まあ　あいつがどんなヤツかは　オマエも知ってるだろ

key: To tell the truth, she and Terra'd probably get along,
en: To tell the truth, she and Terra'd probably get along,
ja: 正直　あいつとテラは　気が合いそうだ

key: If Terra weren't...
en: If Terra weren't...
ja: テラが　あんなふうじゃ　なけりゃな……

key: But she said you got taken by a Necrozma after you beat Lin.
en: But she said you got taken by a Necrozma after you beat Lin.
ja: で　あいつが言うには　オマエはリンを倒したあと　ネクロズマに　連れ去られたんだと

key: Said it swooped in and got you before you could even react.
en: Said it swooped in and got you before you could even react.
ja: 反応する間もなく　舞い降りてきて　さらわれたってな

key: Didn't really know how she could have known that, seeing as she wasn't there,
en: Didn't really know how she could have known that, seeing as she wasn't there,
ja: その場にいなかったのに　なんでそんなこと知ってんのか　さっぱりだったが

key: But when I asked, she just said she had her sources.
en: But when I asked, she just said she had her sources.
ja: 聞いてみたら　情報源が　あるとしか　言わなかった

key: Well, whatever happened, I'm glad it didn't eat you.
en: Well, whatever happened, I'm glad it didn't eat you.
ja: まあ　何があったにせよ　食われなくて　よかったよ

key: SAMSON: I saw Ciel's back.
en: SAMSON: I saw Ciel's back.
ja: サムソン: シエルが戻ってるのを　見たぜ

key: Had a chat with her.
en: Had a chat with her.
ja: ちょっと話もした

key: Heard what you did.
en: Heard what you did.
ja: オマエが　やったことも　聞いた

key: Thanks, champ.
en: Thanks, champ.
ja: ありがとな　チャンプ

key: You did what I couldn't.
en: You did what I couldn't.
ja: オレにできなかったことを　やってくれた

key: And, man... I'll regret saying this,
en: And, man... I'll regret saying this,
ja: それとな……これ言ったら　絶対後悔するけどよ

key: So don't you tell her I said it,
en: So don't you tell her I said it,
ja: あいつには　言うなよ

key: But honestly, I'm just happy she's okay.
en: But honestly, I'm just happy she's okay.
ja: 正直　あいつが無事で　それだけで　うれしいんだ

key: SAMSON: Thanks for bringing the gang back together.
en: SAMSON: Thanks for bringing the gang back together.
ja: サムソン: 仲間を　また集めてくれて　ありがとな

key: It uh...
en: It uh...
ja: その　なんだ……

key: Let's just say our bartending friend was starting to get a little concerned about me and my intake volume before.
en: Let's just say our bartending friend was starting to get a little concerned about me and my intake volume before.
ja: 前は　バーテンの兄ちゃんが　オレの酒の量を　ちょっと心配し始めてた……とだけ　言っとくよ

key: Trying to run from the loneliness.
en: Trying to run from the loneliness.
ja: さびしさから　逃げようとしてな

key: Listen, you can't tell them I said this, right?
en: Listen, you can't tell them I said this, right?
ja: なあ　これ　あいつらには　言わないでくれよ?

key: I'll never hear the end of it.
en: I'll never hear the end of it.
ja: 一生　からかわれちまう

key: You did good, Champ.
en: You did good, Champ.
ja: よくやったな　チャンプ

key: SAMSON: Nice work winning the tournament.
en: SAMSON: Nice work winning the tournament.
ja: サムソン: 大会優勝　やったな

key: The boss still isn't quite over it.
en: The boss still isn't quite over it.
ja: ボスは　まだ引きずってるぜ

key: Now and then she mutters about 'the best act that got away'.
en: Now and then she mutters about 'the best act that got away'.
ja: ときどき『逃した　最高の演目』って　ぼやいてる

key: Well.
en: Well.
ja: まあな

key: Circus isn't a bad place to work. That Pokémon would've been treated well enough,
en: Circus isn't a bad place to work. That Pokémon would've been treated well enough,
ja: サーカスは　悪い職場じゃない。あのポケモンも　それなりに　大事にされただろうさ

key: But honestly...
en: But honestly...
ja: でも　正直な話……

key: Between you and me, I'm glad you won.
en: Between you and me, I'm glad you won.
ja: ここだけの話　オマエが勝ってくれて　よかったと思ってる

key: Just keep her out of trouble, would you?
en: Just keep her out of trouble, would you?
ja: あいつが　面倒を起こさないように　見ててやってくれよ?

key: And maybe... away from the boss.
en: And maybe... away from the boss.
ja: それと……できれば　ボスからも　遠ざけといてくれ

key: SAMSON: Nothing at space junk site #3002, was I right?
en: SAMSON: Nothing at space junk site #3002, was I right?
ja: サムソン: 宇宙ゴミ地点　3002番は　何もなかっただろ?

key: Telling you, these New World pockets are a dime a dozen.
en: Telling you, these New World pockets are a dime a dozen.
ja: 言ったろ　ああいう新世界の裂け目なんて　掃いて捨てるほど　あるんだよ

key: We may as well not even explore them.
en: We may as well not even explore them.
ja: わざわざ　調べる価値も　ないくらいだ

key: If there's nothing running out of it screaming, what's the big idea, right?
en: If there's nothing running out of it screaming, what's the big idea, right?
ja: 中から　わめきながら　何かが飛び出してこないなら　大したことないだろ?

key: Basic triage.
en: Basic triage.
ja: 基本の　優先順位ってヤツだ

key: For instance, there was this time a bit ago, I think around the time you were helping out those Meteor girls...
en: For instance, there was this time a bit ago, I think around the time you were helping out those Meteor girls...
ja: たとえば　ちょっと前……オマエが　あのメテオの姉ちゃんたちを　助けてたころだと思うが

key: We were out at the bridge, and suddenly,
en: We were out at the bridge, and suddenly,
ja: オレたちは　橋のところにいてな　そしたら突然

key: Boom--
en: Boom--
ja: ドカン――

key: Like three of those ugly Buzzwole things just blast out of nowhere and start swarming people.
en: Like three of those ugly Buzzwole things just blast out of nowhere and start swarming people.
ja: あのブサイクな　マッシブーンってヤツが　三体くらい　どこからともなく　飛び出してきて　人に群がり始めた

key: Now, we were all there, all three of us--
en: Now, we were all there, all three of us--
ja: そのとき　オレたち三人　全員そろってた――

key: Thanks to you, mind--
en: Thanks to you, mind--
ja: オマエのおかげでな――

key: One goes off flying and Ciel can chase it down.
en: One goes off flying and Ciel can chase it down.
ja: 一体は　飛んで逃げて　シエルが追いかけた

key: One goes straight for a civ'.
en: One goes straight for a civ'.
ja: 一体は　まっすぐ民間人に　突っ込んでいった

key: I slug it in its ugly mug, three minutes later I've got it in a chokehold.
en: I slug it in its ugly mug, three minutes later I've got it in a chokehold.
ja: オレは　そのブサイクな面を　ぶん殴って　三分後には　首を締め上げてた

key: I'll spare you the details of what Terra did with hers.
en: I'll spare you the details of what Terra did with hers.
ja: テラが　自分の相手に　何をしたかは　言わないでおく

key: Point is, we got a bulletin about a new space only a few moments before.
en: Point is, we got a bulletin about a new space only a few moments before.
ja: 要は　その少し前に　新しい空間の通報が　入ってたってことだ

key: If we'd dashed off to deal with it, who'd've saved the civ, you know?
en: If we'd dashed off to deal with it, who'd've saved the civ, you know?
ja: そっちに　飛んでってたら　あの民間人は　誰が助けたんだ? な?

key: Smart priorities, Champ.
en: Smart priorities, Champ.
ja: 優先順位を　しっかりな　チャンプ

key: Stay vigilant.
en: Stay vigilant.
ja: 気を抜くなよ

key: SAMSON: How much you wanna bet I can beat the champion savior of the region in an arm wrestle match?
en: SAMSON: How much you wanna bet I can beat the champion savior of the region in an arm wrestle match?
ja: サムソン: 地方を救ったチャンピオンに　腕相撲で勝てるほうに　いくら賭ける?

key: Technically, that makes me the strongest, right?
en: Technically, that makes me the strongest, right?
ja: 理屈のうえじゃ　それでオレが　いちばん強いってことに　なるよな?

key: SAMSON: You finally made it to the top.
en: SAMSON: You finally made it to the top.
ja: サムソン: とうとう　頂点まで　行っちまったな

key: Lonely, isn't it?
en: Lonely, isn't it?
ja: さびしいもんだろ?

key: Now you see why the rest of us are down here.
en: Now you see why the rest of us are down here.
ja: オレたちが　下にいる理由が　分かったろ

key: SAMSON: Join me for a shot sometime.
en: SAMSON: Join me for a shot sometime.
ja: サムソン: そのうち　一杯　付き合えよ

key: I won't tell if you're not of age.
en: I won't tell if you're not of age.
ja: 歳が足りてなくても　黙っといてやる

key: Champ deserves a drink or two.
en: Champ deserves a drink or two.
ja: チャンプなら　一杯や二杯　飲む資格が　あるだろ

key: SAMSON: Keep at it, champ.
en: SAMSON: Keep at it, champ.
ja: サムソン: 続けてけよ　チャンプ

key: You never know who might just lap you if you don't.
en: You never know who might just lap you if you don't.
ja: サボってたら　誰に追い抜かれるか　分からんぞ

key: SAMSON: I'm just chilling here, if you're bored.
en: SAMSON: I'm just chilling here, if you're bored.
ja: サムソン: 退屈なら　オレは　ここでのんびりしてるぜ

key: The boss sure as hell doesn't pay me enough not to kick back when I can.
en: The boss sure as hell doesn't pay me enough not to kick back when I can.
ja: ボスの給料じゃ　休めるときに　休まなきゃ　やってられん

key: CHARLOTTE: Whoa, \PN?
en: CHARLOTTE: Whoa, \PN?
ja: シャルロット: うわっ　\PN?

key: ...Huh.
en: ...Huh.
ja: ……ふーん

key: So tell me.
en: So tell me.
ja: ねえ　教えてよ

key: Did Lin really turn you into a baby, or was Julia pranking me?
en: Did Lin really turn you into a baby, or was Julia pranking me?
ja: リンに　赤ちゃんにされたって　ホント? それとも　ジュリアの　からかい?

key: It sounded kinda convincing, but...
en: It sounded kinda convincing, but...
ja: わりと　それっぽく　聞こえたけど……

key: You don't look like a baby.
en: You don't look like a baby.
ja: アンタ　赤ちゃんには　見えないし

key: CHARLOTTE: Nothing, huh?
en: CHARLOTTE: Nothing, huh?
ja: シャルロット: 何もなし　ってわけ?

key: Well, whatever. Glad you're not a baby now, at least.
en: Well, whatever. Glad you're not a baby now, at least.
ja: まあ　どうでもいいけど。とりあえず　今は赤ちゃんじゃなくて　よかったわ

key: Babies can be kind of annoying, but you're fun to hang out with.
en: Babies can be kind of annoying, but you're fun to hang out with.
ja: 赤ちゃんって　ちょっと面倒だし　アンタと　つるむのは　楽しいもの

key: Babies can be kind of annoying.
en: Babies can be kind of annoying.
ja: 赤ちゃんって　ちょっと面倒だしね

key: CHARLOTTE: I suppose you didn't conveniently forget everything that happened at the Mirage Tower did you?
en: CHARLOTTE: I suppose you didn't conveniently forget everything that happened at the Mirage Tower did you?
ja: シャルロット: しんきろうの塔で　あったこと　都合よく　全部忘れてたり……しないよね?

key: Please?
en: Please?
ja: お願いだから

key: Because if not, I'm gonna have to come up with some edgy, dramatic spiel to save my image.
en: Because if not, I'm gonna have to come up with some edgy, dramatic spiel to save my image.
ja: 忘れてないなら　アタシ　イメージを守るために　イタくてドラマチックな　セリフを　考えなきゃ　いけなくなる

key: In fact, let's just both pretend I did that already, cool?
en: In fact, let's just both pretend I did that already, cool?
ja: ていうか　もう　それやったことに　しない? ね?

key: Cool.
en: Cool.
ja: よし　決まり

key: I'm only upset ironically or something.
en: I'm only upset ironically or something.
ja: アタシが　落ち込んでるのは　ネタみたいなもんだから

key: So yeah, uh, don't forget it or whatever.
en: So yeah, uh, don't forget it or whatever.
ja: まあ　その　忘れないでよね　べつに　どうでもいいけど

key: CHARLOTTE: I heard a Meloetta was causing trouble at the circus earlier.
en: CHARLOTTE: I heard a Meloetta was causing trouble at the circus earlier.
ja: シャルロット: この前　サーカスで　メロエッタが　騒ぎを起こしたって　聞いたけど

key: I assume you caught it?
en: I assume you caught it?
ja: どうせ　アンタが　捕まえたんでしょ?

key: I mean, good for you, but honestly?
en: I mean, good for you, but honestly?
ja: まあ　よかったじゃない。でも　正直に言うとさ

key: I don't get what the big deal is.
en: I don't get what the big deal is.
ja: 何が　そんなに　すごいのか　分かんない

key: From what Serra said, there was a whole crowd there wanting to meet it?
en: From what Serra said, there was a whole crowd there wanting to meet it?
ja: セラの話だと　会いたがる人が　どっと　押しかけたんだって?

key: But... there's legendary Pokémon all over the place.
en: But... there's legendary Pokémon all over the place.
ja: でも……伝説のポケモンなんて　そこらじゅうに　いるじゃない

key: What made everyone go gaga for Meloetta in particular?
en: What made everyone go gaga for Meloetta in particular?
ja: なんで　メロエッタだけ　あんなに　みんな夢中に　なったわけ?

key: Was it the Anomaly aura or something?
en: Was it the Anomaly aura or something?
ja: アノマリーのオーラとか　そういうの?

key: I dunno. I don't get it.
en: I dunno. I don't get it.
ja: 知らないけど。よく分かんない

key: But hey, maybe you can introduce me sometime and I'll see what all the fuss is about.
en: But hey, maybe you can introduce me sometime and I'll see what all the fuss is about.
ja: まあ　そのうち　紹介してよ。何がそんなに　騒がれてるのか　見てあげる

key: CHARLOTTE: Huh?
en: CHARLOTTE: Huh?
ja: シャルロット: ん?

key: Oh, hey.
en: Oh, hey.
ja: ああ　アンタか

key: Just finishing up this book.
en: Just finishing up this book.
ja: この本　読み終わるとこ

key: I know this is a weird place to read, but Shelly loaned it to me, and I want to give it back before she leaves.
en: I know this is a weird place to read, but Shelly loaned it to me, and I want to give it back before she leaves.
ja: 読書するには　変な場所だって　分かってる。でも　シェリーが貸してくれた本だから　あの子が帰る前に　返したいの

key: Did you know she has all kinds of wicked books in that library in her Gym?
en: Did you know she has all kinds of wicked books in that library in her Gym?
ja: あの子のジムの図書室　イカした本が　いろいろあるの　知ってた?

key: This one's about a warlock whose family died in a fire, so he goes on a suicidal revenge mission...
en: This one's about a warlock whose family died in a fire, so he goes on a suicidal revenge mission...
ja: これは　火事で家族を亡くした魔導士が　死ぬ覚悟で　かたき討ちに　出る話でね……

key: ...But he doesn't know that he was actually the one who caused the fire.
en: ...But he doesn't know that he was actually the one who caused the fire.
ja: ……でも　その火事を起こしたのが　自分だってことを　彼は知らないの

key: It's pretty cool, but I've got some... mixed feelings about it.
en: It's pretty cool, but I've got some... mixed feelings about it.
ja: かなりイイんだけど……ちょっと　複雑な気分でもある

key: I'm just finishing this up, though.
en: I'm just finishing this up, though.

key: I'll tell you about it after, though, in case you want to check it out.
en: I'll tell you about it after, though, in case you want to check it out.
ja: あとで　話してあげる。読んでみたく　なるかもしれないでしょ

key: CHARLOTTE: Sup?
en: CHARLOTTE: Sup?
ja: シャルロット: なに?

key: CHARLOTTE: Hey, ready to eat dirt in a rematch?

en: Oh, don't worry!
ja: あっ　気にしないでください!

key: I know I missed this picnic, but there will always be others!
en: I know I missed this picnic, but there will always be others!
ja: 今回は　行けませんでしたけど　機会は　またありますから!

key: This region is so beautiful, after all-- there are so many places to go and things to see.
en: This region is so beautiful, after all-- there are so many places to go and things to see.
ja: この地方は　とても美しいですし――行きたい場所も　見たいものも　たくさんあります

key: And maybe next time, Bennett and my sisters will be able to make it, too!
en: And maybe next time, Bennett and my sisters will be able to make it, too!
ja: 次は　ベネットや　姉妹たちも　来られるかもしれません!

key: LAURA: I hope you've been taking care of yourself?
en: LAURA: I hope you've been taking care of yourself?
ja: ローラ: ちゃんと　体を　大事にしていますか?

key: Actually, I'm glad you stopped by.
en: Actually, I'm glad you stopped by.
ja: ちょうど　寄ってくれて　よかったです

key: I........ wasn't exactly thrilled, when I found out Bennett had sent you out to check on me,
en: I........ wasn't exactly thrilled, when I found out Bennett had sent you out to check on me,
ja: わたし……ベネットが　あなたを　様子を見に　行かせたと知ったときは　正直　いい気は　しませんでした

key: But at the same time, I was very grateful.
en: But at the same time, I was very grateful.
ja: でも　同時に　とても　ありがたかったんです

key: I was so worried, and........
en: I was so worried, and........
ja: とても　心配で　それに……

key: I couldn't handle it on my own.
en: I couldn't handle it on my own.
ja: わたし一人では　どうにも　できませんでした

key: But you found them both, safe and sound.
en: But you found them both, safe and sound.
ja: でも　あなたが　二人とも　無事に　見つけてくれた

key: And as worried as I'd been, when I saw them both, I was even happier.
en: And as worried as I'd been, when I saw them both, I was even happier.
ja: あれだけ心配していた分　二人の顔を見たときは　もっと　うれしかった

key: I really appreciate your help.
en: I really appreciate your help.
ja: 力になってくれて　本当に　感謝しています

key: Things with my sisters........
en: Things with my sisters........
ja: 姉妹との　ことは……

key: Aren't going to be as easy to patch up as I'd hoped.
en: Aren't going to be as easy to patch up as I'd hoped.
ja: 思っていたほど　簡単には　元どおりに　ならないみたいです

key: But while we were out there, I felt like we were taking steps forward.
en: But while we were out there, I felt like we were taking steps forward.
ja: でも　一緒にいるあいだ　少しずつ　前に進めている　気がしました

key: They may have been baby steps,
en: They may have been baby steps,
ja: ほんの　小さな一歩だったかもしれませんけど

key: But any step forward is better than none at all!
en: But any step forward is better than none at all!
ja: 止まっているより　ずっと　いいですよね!

key: I have faith in all of us.
en: I have faith in all of us.
ja: わたしは　わたしたち　みんなを　信じています

key: LAURA: It's good to see you again outside of battle, haha!
en: LAURA: It's good to see you again outside of battle, haha!
ja: ローラ: バトル以外で　また会えて　うれしいです。ふふっ!

key: Truthfully, I was a bit........ concerned for you.
en: Truthfully, I was a bit........ concerned for you.
ja: 正直に言うと　少し……あなたのことが　心配でした

key: That girl who was with you-- Flora, I think her name was?
en: That girl who was with you-- Flora, I think her name was?
ja: 一緒にいた　あの子――フローラ　という名前でしたよね?

key: She was a bit........
en: She was a bit........
ja: あの子は　少し……
その……

key: Well, she reminded me a little of Charlotte,
en: Well, she reminded me a little of Charlotte,
ja: なんだか　シャルロットを　少し　思い出してしまって

key: When Charlotte was at her worst.
en: When Charlotte was at her worst.
ja: 一番　荒れていたころの　シャルロットを

key: So angry, and dismissive.
en: So angry, and dismissive.
ja: 怒ってばかりで　人を　見下していて

key: But Charlotte--
en: But Charlotte--
ja: でも　シャルロットは――

key: I won't say she's perfect now, but she's certainly gotten better.
en: I won't say she's perfect now, but she's certainly gotten better.
ja: 今も　完ぺきとは　言いませんけど　確かに　良くなりました

key: And I really hope Flora can, too!
en: And I really hope Flora can, too!
ja: だから　フローラも　きっと　変われると　思うんです!

key: I'm sure she can. She just needs a little time to grow, and some people to believe in her.
en: I'm sure she can. She just needs a little time to grow, and some people to believe in her.
ja: きっと　大丈夫。育つための　時間と　信じてくれる人が　少し　必要なだけ

key: I’m glad you were able to be there for her, \PN, at least for a little while.
en: I’m glad you were able to be there for her, \PN, at least for a little while.
ja: 短いあいだでも　あの子のそばに　いてあげられて　よかったですね　\PN

key: LAURA: I was talking to Serra a little while ago, and she told me about the adventure you had with Victini!
en: LAURA: I was talking to Serra a little while ago, and she told me about the adventure you had with Victini!
ja: ローラ: 少し前に　セラと話したんですけど　ビクティニとの冒険のこと　聞きましたよ!

key: It sounds like a nice trip you all had.
en: It sounds like a nice trip you all had.
ja: みなさん　すてきな旅を　したみたいですね

key: I wonder why Bennett didn't tell me, though........
en: I wonder why Bennett didn't tell me, though........
ja: でも　どうして　ベネットは　教えてくれなかったのかしら……

key: I never knew he could cook!
en: I never knew he could cook!
ja: 料理ができるなんて　知りませんでした!

key: Haha, I wish I'd been able to see it!
en: Haha, I wish I'd been able to see it!
ja: ふふっ　わたしも　見たかったです!

key: Maybe I'll go check out Aegir Cave sometime, when the League's not too busy.
en: Maybe I'll go check out Aegir Cave sometime, when the League's not too busy.
ja: リーグが　落ち着いたら　エーギルどうくつに　行ってみようかしら

key: If you wanted to come along, that would be amazing!
en: If you wanted to come along, that would be amazing!
ja: もし　一緒に来てくれるなら　とても　うれしいです!

key: Maybe we could get some more people to come along, too........
en: Maybe we could get some more people to come along, too........
ja: ほかの人たちも　誘えたら　いいですね……

key: We could make a whole picnic! Or even a tea party!
en: We could make a whole picnic! Or even a tea party!
ja: みんなで　ピクニックにしても! お茶会でも　いいですね!

key: Aah, a tea party with friends sounds lovely.
en: Aah, a tea party with friends sounds lovely.
ja: ああ　友達との　お茶会　すてきです

key: I'll talk to everyone and let you know, okay?
en: I'll talk to everyone and let you know, okay?
ja: みんなに　話してみて　また　お知らせしますね

key: Before I do, though........
en: Before I do, though........
ja: その前に……

key: I wanted to thank you for being there for Bennett.
en: I wanted to thank you for being there for Bennett.
ja: ベネットの　そばにいてくれて　ありがとう　と　言いたかったんです

key: I know you've had some trouble in the past, and I'm really grateful you're giving him another chance.
en: I know you've had some trouble in the past, and I'm really grateful you're giving him another chance.
ja: 過去に　いろいろ　あったのに　もう一度　チャンスを　くれて　本当に　感謝しています

key: I know it means a lot to him, too.
en: I know it means a lot to him, too.
ja: あの人にとっても　大きな意味が　あるはずです

key: LAURA: Bennett and I were just talking about the League.
en: LAURA: Bennett and I were just talking about the League.
ja: ローラ: ちょうど　ベネットと　リーグの話を　していたんです

key: It's been........ fairly quiet, since all of this started up.
en: It's been........ fairly quiet, since all of this started up.
ja: この騒ぎが　始まってから……ずいぶん　静かで

key: I guess since most people who would be strong enough to challenge the Elite Four are already helping out here, with all the Legendaries.
en: I guess since most people who would be strong enough to challenge the Elite Four are already helping out here, with all the Legendaries.
ja: 四天王に挑めるほど　強い人は　たいてい　伝説のポケモンの件で　こちらを　手伝っていますから

key: And I don't mind the quiet, really!
en: And I don't mind the quiet, really!
ja: 静かなのは　べつに　いやじゃないんですよ!

key: But I can't help worrying a little, about Bennett.
en: But I can't help worrying a little, about Bennett.
ja: でも　ベネットのことが　少し　心配で

key: He's only just got the position, and........
en: He's only just got the position, and........
ja: あの人は　その地位に　就いたばかりですし……

key: Please don't tell him I told you, but I think he might still be beating himself up a little.
en: Please don't tell him I told you, but I think he might still be beating himself up a little.
ja: 本人には　内緒にしてほしいんですけど　まだ　自分を　責めているみたいなんです

key: About what happened before, I mean.
en: About what happened before, I mean.
ja: 以前のことを　です

key: Anyway, I think it might help him if he could do some more battling, just to remind himself that he deserves to be there.
en: Anyway, I think it might help him if he could do some more battling, just to remind himself that he deserves to be there.
ja: だから　もっとバトルができれば　自分は　そこにいていいんだと　思い出せて　いいと思うんです

key: So, for his sake, I hope the League gets some more challengers soon.
en: So, for his sake, I hope the League gets some more challengers soon.
ja: あの人のためにも　リーグに　挑戦者が　もっと来てくれると　いいのですけど

key: And for yours, of course, new Champion!
en: And for yours, of course, new Champion!
ja: もちろん　新チャンピオンの　あなたのためにも!

key: LAURA: I can hardly agree with this atmosphere, but........
en: LAURA: I can hardly agree with this atmosphere, but........
ja: ローラ: この雰囲気は　あまり　好みでは　ないのですけど……

key: I'm glad that everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
en: I'm glad that everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.
ja: みんなが　楽しそうで　なによりです

key: LAURA: You'll come by my garden again some time, won't you?
en: LAURA: You'll come by my garden again some time, won't you?
ja: ローラ: また　わたしの庭に　来てくださいますよね?

key: LAURA: Do you think that bar carries herbal teas?
en: LAURA: Do you think that bar carries herbal teas?
ja: ローラ: あのバーには　ハーブティーも　あるのかしら?

key: I haven't wanted to bother about it........
en: I haven't wanted to bother about it........
ja: わざわざ　たずねるのも　気が引けて……

key: LAURA: Make sure you're taking plenty of breaks and staying hydrated!
en: LAURA: Make sure you're taking plenty of breaks and staying hydrated!
ja: ローラ: しっかり休んで　水分も　たくさん取ってくださいね!

key: People aren't so different from flowers.
en: People aren't so different from flowers.
ja: 人も　花と　そう変わりません

key: We all need time to grow.
en: We all need time to grow.
ja: 育つには　だれにでも　時間が　必要なんです

key: ELIAS: Master \PN!
en: ELIAS: Master \PN!
ja: イライアス: \PN様!

key: I heard you've decided to grace us with your presence once again...
en: I heard you've decided to grace us with your presence once again...
ja: ふたたび　我らの前に　姿を　お見せくださったと　うかがいました……

key: I dare not pretend I understand your intentions, but know that I am humbled, repentant, and beholden nonetheless.
en: I dare not pretend I understand your intentions, but know that I am humbled, repentant, and beholden nonetheless.
ja: あなた様の　お考えを　理解しているなどとは　申しません。ですが　私は　ただ　頭を垂れ　悔い改め　恩義を　感じております

key: It is for this reason that I've returned to see of what service I may be.
en: It is for this reason that I've returned to see of what service I may be.
ja: ゆえに　私は　なにか　お役に立てることは　ないかと　戻ってまいりました

key: If you have but a moment to listen to the apologies of a humiliated servant--
en: If you have but a moment to listen to the apologies of a humiliated servant--
ja: 恥をさらした　しもべの　わびごとに　少しだけ　耳を　お貸しいただけるなら――

key: I wish to express my heartfelt regret for my prior blindness.
en: I wish to express my heartfelt regret for my prior blindness.
ja: かつての　私の盲目さについて　心からの　悔いを　お伝えしたいのです

key: Not any blindness that affected my eyes, no-- but the blindness of my misplaced faith.
en: Not any blindness that affected my eyes, no-- but the blindness of my misplaced faith.
ja: 目が　見えぬという意味では　ありません――誤った信仰に　目を　くらませていたという　意味です

key: Truth be bared, I have been informed as to your true nature...
en: Truth be bared, I have been informed as to your true nature...
ja: 包み隠さず　申し上げれば　私は　あなた様の　真の姿を　知らされております……

key: That is, that you are the avatar of Arceus--
en: That is, that you are the avatar of Arceus--
ja: すなわち　あなた様は　アルセウスの　化身であると――

key: Do not try to deny it, Master \PN. It is by your power that my eyes are open now.
en: Do not try to deny it, Master \PN. It is by your power that my eyes are open now.
ja: 否定なさいますな　\PN様。私の目が　今　開いているのは　あなた様の　お力によるもの

key: I understand fully how it was you who willed Meteor unmade, and how you triumphed over the blasphemer Lin to save your own kin.
en: I understand fully how it was you who willed Meteor unmade, and how you triumphed over the blasphemer Lin to save your own kin.
ja: メテオを　消し去ることを　望まれたのも　冒とく者リンを　打ち倒し　同胞を　救われたのも　すべて　あなた様であると　よく　分かっております

key: Of course, I am not without discretion.
en: Of course, I am not without discretion.
ja: むろん　私にも　分別は　ございます

key: I understand that any attempts to deny this truth are merely to preserve the sanctity of your secret, privacy, and the faith you ask from others.
en: I understand that any attempts to deny this truth are merely to preserve the sanctity of your secret, privacy, and the faith you ask from others.
ja: この真実を　否定なさるのは　あなた様の秘密と　安らぎ　そして　人々に求める信仰の　尊さを　守るためだと　理解しております

key: This, I shall respect unflinchingly.
en: This, I shall respect unflinchingly.
ja: その意思を　私は　ゆるぎなく　尊重いたします

key: In the meantime, from now until the end of my days, please understand that if you need anything at all,
en: In the meantime, from now until the end of my days, please understand that if you need anything at all,
ja: この先　命の尽きる日まで　もし　なにか　入り用のものが　あれば

key: I am wholly at your disposal.
en: I am wholly at your disposal.
ja: この身は　すべて　あなた様の　ものと　お心得ください

key: ELIAS: My Lord...
en: ELIAS: My Lord...
ja: イライアス: 我が主よ……

key: I see you have returned my Master's progeny to us after all...
en: I see you have returned my Master's progeny to us after all...
ja: やはり　あなた様は　我が旧き主の　血を引く者を　我らのもとへ　お返しくださったのですね……

key: That your mercy and power would run even this deep...
en: That your mercy and power would run even this deep...
ja: あなた様の　慈悲と　お力が　これほどまで　深いとは……

key: Truly...
en: Truly...
ja: まことに……

key: I am moved to tears of joy...
en: I am moved to tears of joy...
ja: 喜びの涙が　あふれてまいります……

key: ...Though, I also received a curious report recently.
en: ...Though, I also received a curious report recently.
ja: ……ですが　最近　奇妙な報告も　受けました

key: There was a blaze within the sanctum?
en: There was a blaze within the sanctum?
ja: 聖堂の中で　火の手が　上がったとか?

key: And the entrance has been sealed?
en: And the entrance has been sealed?
ja: そして　入り口が　封じられたとか?

key: These events...
en: These events...
ja: これらの　できごと……

key: Surely would not be related...
en: Surely would not be related...
ja: まさか　関わりが　あるはずも……

key: Would they...
en: Would they...
ja: ございませんよね……

key: ...My Lord?
en: ...My Lord?
ja: ……我が主よ?

key: I had many personal affects in there.
en: I had many personal affects in there.
ja: あそこには　私の　個人的な品が　多く　ございました

key: Memorabilia, personal writings, sermons and scripts, and tokens of history, both of the order and of my time with my dear former master...
en: Memorabilia, personal writings, sermons and scripts, and tokens of history, both of the order and of my time with my dear former master...
ja: 思い出の品　手記　説教の草稿　そして　教団と　敬愛する旧き主との　日々を　物語る　数々の品が……

key: If that has all been lost...
en: If that has all been lost...
ja: それが　すべて　失われたのだとしたら……

key: ...Please forgive me, my Lord.
en: ...Please forgive me, my Lord.
ja: ……どうか　お許しを　我が主よ

key: I have just remembered that I needed to inspect the quality of the stock back here.
en: I have just remembered that I needed to inspect the quality of the stock back here.
ja: たった今　奥の酒の　品質を　確かめねばならぬことを　思い出しました

key: ...I believe I shall be inspecting and sampling it quite thoroughly for some time.
en: ...I believe I shall be inspecting and sampling it quite thoroughly for some time.
ja: ……しばらくのあいだ　じっくりと　念入りに　味見をして　まいります

key: ELIAS: I say, there was quite a strapping young Trainer around here recently.
en: ELIAS: I say, there was quite a strapping young Trainer around here recently.
ja: イライアス: いやはや　最近　実に　りりしい　若きトレーナーが　この辺りに　おりましてな

key: Sunglasses and a black coat and hat...
en: Sunglasses and a black coat and hat...
ja: サングラスに　黒いコートと　帽子……

key: A wonderful choice of attire if I do say so myself.
en: A wonderful choice of attire if I do say so myself.
ja: 自分で言うのも　なんですが　実に　見事な　装いでした

key: ELIAS: To have been on a pilgrimage with you by my side,
en: ELIAS: To have been on a pilgrimage with you by my side,
ja: イライアス: あなた様と　共に　巡礼の旅に　出られたこと

key: And to have witnessed the future for myself,
en: And to have witnessed the future for myself,
ja: そして　この目で　未来を　見届けられたこと

key: With these two eyes that you gave me...
en: With these two eyes that you gave me...
ja: あなた様が　与えてくださった　この　二つの目で……

key: No amount of devotion is equal to my debt.
en: No amount of devotion is equal to my debt.
ja: どれほど　身をささげようと　この恩には　到底　及びません

key: For as long as I yet draw breath, I shall not forget this blessing.
en: For as long as I yet draw breath, I shall not forget this blessing.
ja: 息のあるかぎり　この恵みを　忘れは　いたしません

key: ELIAS: Greetings, Master \PN.
en: ELIAS: Greetings, Master \PN.
ja: イライアス: ごきげんよう　\PN様

key: It has... been an ordeal, has it not?
en: It has... been an ordeal, has it not?
ja: あれは……なかなかの　試練でしたな

key: I refer, of course, to our prior battle, and the guest who accompanied you.
en: I refer, of course, to our prior battle, and the guest who accompanied you.
ja: むろん　先のバトルと　あなた様に　同行していた　客人のことです

key: I understand well that I am not well-versed in the ways of the young,
en: I understand well that I am not well-versed in the ways of the young,
ja: 私が　お若い方々の　流儀に　うといことは　承知しております

key: But it seems to me that that young woman was particularly spiteful.
en: But it seems to me that that young woman was particularly spiteful.
ja: ですが　あの　お若い女性は　とりわけ　とげとげしく　見えました

key: Her strength in battle was admirable, but I fear that the strength of her character was not its equal.
en: Her strength in battle was admirable, but I fear that the strength of her character was not its equal.
ja: バトルの強さは　見事でしたが　人としての強さは　それに　及ばぬように　思われます

key: But she is yet young-- perhaps there is still time for her to learn.
en: But she is yet young-- perhaps there is still time for her to learn.
ja: しかし　まだ　お若い――学ぶ時間は　残されているでしょう

key: Here I am, going on. Forgive me, my Lord.
en: Here I am, going on. Forgive me, my Lord.
ja: つい　長話を。お許しください　我が主よ

key: I am sure there is none of this that you do not know already.
en: I am sure there is none of this that you do not know already.
ja: こんなことは　すでに　すべて　ご存じでしょうに

key: As always, your patience is admirable.
en: As always, your patience is admirable.
ja: いつもながら　あなた様の　しんぼう強さには　頭が下がります

key: With myself, as well as... others.
en: With myself, as well as... others.
ja: 私に対しても……ほかの者に対しても

key: ELIAS: My Lord!
en: ELIAS: My Lord!
ja: イライアス: 我が主よ!

key: My apologies. \PN.
en: My apologies. \PN.
ja: 失礼いたしました　\PN

key: Please, have a seat, if you have the time.
en: Please, have a seat, if you have the time.
ja: お時間が　あるようでしたら　どうぞ　おかけください

key: I understand your time is valuable,
en: I understand your time is valuable,
ja: あなた様の時間が　貴重なことは　承知しております

key: And there is much still to do.
en: And there is much still to do.
ja: まだ　なすべきことも　多い

key: But if ever you are in need of rest,
en: But if ever you are in need of rest,
ja: ですが　休息が　必要なときは

key: Or even want of it,
en: Or even want of it,
ja: いえ　ただ　休みたいと　思うだけでも

key: This may be a good place to do so.
en: This may be a good place to do so.
ja: ここは　うってつけの場所かも　しれません

key: If truth be bared, I have found it... a strangely good place to contemplate some things.
en: If truth be bared, I have found it... a strangely good place to contemplate some things.
ja: 正直に　申しますと　ここは……不思議と　物事を　じっくり考えるのに　良い場所なのです

key: ELIAS: Ah, my child has taken one step into the light.
en: ELIAS: Ah, my child has taken one step into the light.
ja: イライアス: ああ　我が子が　光の中へ　一歩　踏み出しました

key: This, too, is your doing,
en: This, too, is your doing,
ja: これもまた　あなた様の　お導き

key: Isn't it, my Lord?

ja: アーク: だが　説明することが　山ほどある

key: Why don't you come on over here?
en: Why don't you come on over here?
ja: こっちに　来てくれるか?

key: ARC: I'd ask where in the world you've been, but for better or worse, I've got a few guesses on the matter.
en: ARC: I'd ask where in the world you've been, but for better or worse, I've got a few guesses on the matter.
ja: アーク: どこに行ってたんだ　と　聞きたいところだが　良くも悪くも　見当は　ついてる

key: Lemme cut straight to the chase--
en: Lemme cut straight to the chase--
ja: 手短に　いこう――

key: Meteor's out, but the chaos is still in.
en: Meteor's out, but the chaos is still in.
ja: メテオは　消えた。だが　混乱は　まだ　残ってる

key: The good news is that any grunts that weren't turned in turned over a new leaf, and the admins...
en: The good news is that any grunts that weren't turned in turned over a new leaf, and the admins...
ja: いい知らせは　突き出されなかった下っ端が　みんな　心を入れかえたってことだ。それに　幹部連中は……

key: Well, ain't none of them left.
en: Well, ain't none of them left.
ja: まあ　一人も　残っちゃいない

key: Not even Lin, thanks to you.
en: Not even Lin, thanks to you.
ja: リンさえもな。おまえのおかげだ

key: Anyone who still had ties in the higher ranks is on our side now.
en: Anyone who still had ties in the higher ranks is on our side now.
ja: 上のほうと　つながりが　残ってたやつも　今は　全員　こっち側だ

key: It's a total team KO if ever I've seen one.
en: It's a total team KO if ever I've seen one.
ja: 見事な　チーム全滅ってやつさ

key: The bad news is that the damage is done.
en: The bad news is that the damage is done.
ja: 悪い知らせは　被害が　もう　出ちまったってことだ

key: Their goal of opening the New World ultimately succeeded.
en: Their goal of opening the New World ultimately succeeded.
ja: 新世界を　開くという　やつらの目的は　結局　果たされた

key: Thanks to you, it didn't get so far as overwriting this one, but...
en: Thanks to you, it didn't get so far as overwriting this one, but...
ja: おまえのおかげで　この世界を　塗りかえるまでは　いかなかったが……

key: To put it simply, they're starting to overlap.
en: To put it simply, they're starting to overlap.
ja: 早い話　二つの世界が　重なりはじめてる

key: The unformed New World has been leaking into ours for quite some time now, causing this, that, and the other problem.
en: The unformed New World has been leaking into ours for quite some time now, causing this, that, and the other problem.
ja: 形の定まらない新世界が　しばらく前から　こっちに　もれ出してて　あちこちで　問題を　起こしてるんだ

key: For one thing, the energy from the New World has awoken new heights of potential in Pokémon everywhere.
en: For one thing, the energy from the New World has awoken new heights of potential in Pokémon everywhere.
ja: まず　新世界のエネルギーが　あちこちのポケモンの　新しい可能性を　目覚めさせた

key: Where it was impossible to go above Level 100 before, Pokémon have been sighted growing to as high as Level 150 now.
en: Where it was impossible to go above Level 100 before, Pokémon have been sighted growing to as high as Level 150 now.
ja: 前は　レベル100を　超えられなかったのに　今じゃ　レベル150まで　育ったポケモンが　目撃されてる

key: Double the worlds, double the power-- or somethin'.
en: Double the worlds, double the power-- or somethin'.
ja: 世界が二倍なら　力も二倍――ってとこか

key: An' there's one other... complication.
en: An' there's one other... complication.
ja: それと　もう一つ……やっかいな話がある

key: You know how there's supposed to be some Pokémon out there that there's only one of in the world?
en: You know how there's supposed to be some Pokémon out there that there's only one of in the world?
ja: 世界に　一体しかいない　はずのポケモンが　いるだろ?

key: Yeah, so... about that.
en: Yeah, so... about that.
ja: ああ　その話なんだが……

key: Not... anymore.
en: Not... anymore.
ja: もう……そうじゃない

key: It seems like anything can appear or exist in the New World.
en: It seems like anything can appear or exist in the New World.
ja: 新世界では　なんでも　現れるし　存在できるらしい

key: Uh, so...
en: Uh, so...
ja: つまり　だな……

key: What I'm trying to say here is that yesterday fourteen Genesect fell out of the New World and were running amok on Main Street.
en: What I'm trying to say here is that yesterday fourteen Genesect fell out of the New World and were running amok on Main Street.
ja: オレが　言いたいのは　きのう　ゲノセクトが　十四体　新世界から　落ちてきて　メインストリートで　暴れまわったってことだ

key: We already took care of them, so no need to worry about that, but-- you get the point.
en: We already took care of them, so no need to worry about that, but-- you get the point.
ja: そっちは　もう　片づけたから　心配はいらない。だが――言いたいことは　分かるだろ

key: All sorts of Pokémon have appeared in all sorts of places, but Legendaries in particular, given their big power, tend to create problems when they show up.
en: All sorts of Pokémon have appeared in all sorts of places, but Legendaries in particular, given their big power, tend to create problems when they show up.
ja: いろんなポケモンが　いろんな場所に　現れてる。特に　伝説のポケモンは　力がでかいぶん　現れると　問題を　起こしがちだ

key: For instance, the TV station was totally trashed after a Zapdos spawned inside it...
en: For instance, the TV station was totally trashed after a Zapdos spawned inside it...
ja: たとえば　テレビ局は　中に　サンダーが　現れて　メチャクチャに　なった……

key: Those few seconds of the recording before it cut out were pretty incredible though, can't lie.
en: Those few seconds of the recording before it cut out were pretty incredible though, can't lie.
ja: まあ　映像が　切れるまでの　数秒間は　正直　とんでもなく　すごかったけどな

key: Lots of the other leaders are already away hunting them and putting out Legendary-related fires.
en: Lots of the other leaders are already away hunting them and putting out Legendary-related fires.
ja: ほかのリーダーの多くは　もう　その狩り出しと　伝説がらみの　火消しに　出てる

key: If you're up to it, we can definitely use your help.
en: If you're up to it, we can definitely use your help.
ja: その気があるなら　おまえの力を　ぜひ　借りたい

key: My bad for springin' this on you right when you get back.
en: My bad for springin' this on you right when you get back.
ja: 戻ってきた　そばから　こんな話で　悪いな

key: After shit hit the fan, I decided I'd convert this place into a base of operations for dealing with these kinds of issues all over the city.
en: After shit hit the fan, I decided I'd convert this place into a base of operations for dealing with these kinds of issues all over the city.
ja: 事態が　メチャクチャに　なってから　ここを　街じゅうの　この手の問題に　対処する　拠点に　することにしたんだ

key: By the old policy, only League Leaders and Champions would've been allowed in, but that was Ame's idea, and...
en: By the old policy, only League Leaders and Champions would've been allowed in, but that was Ame's idea, and...
ja: 昔の決まりなら　リーグのリーダーと　チャンピオンしか　入れなかった。だが　あれは　エイミの考えでな……

key: Well, this works out better now anyway.
en: Well, this works out better now anyway.
ja: まあ　今は　このほうが　都合がいい

key: There's a lot of cool stuff in this place that might be worth checking out too, so by all means, take your time!
en: There's a lot of cool stuff in this place that might be worth checking out too, so by all means, take your time!
ja: ここには　見て回る価値のある　おもしろいものが　たくさんある。ぜひ　ゆっくりしていってくれ!

key: We've got an arena behind us that you can use to spar with the friendlies...
en: We've got an arena behind us that you can use to spar with the friendlies...
ja: うしろには　仲間内で　軽く手合わせできる　アリーナがある……

key: The Battle Pavilion's on your left-- free use for all trainers now.
en: The Battle Pavilion's on your left-- free use for all trainers now.
ja: 左手は　バトルパビリオン――今は　どのトレーナーも　自由に　使える

key: No end to the fights there, and you might see some familiar faces.
en: No end to the fights there, and you might see some familiar faces.
ja: バトルは　いくらでも　できるし　見知った顔にも　会えるかもな

key: And finally, I rigged one of the dance floors into a pseudo-map of the region over on the right.
en: And finally, I rigged one of the dance floors into a pseudo-map of the region over on the right.
ja: そして　右手のダンスフロアの一つは　この地方の　簡易マップに　作りかえた

key: We're using that to mark down where reports of New World Anomalies come in-- be it Legendaries or overlap points...
en: We're using that to mark down where reports of New World Anomalies come in-- be it Legendaries or overlap points...
ja: そこに　新世界アノマリーの報告が　入った場所を　書きこんでる――伝説のポケモンでも　世界の重なり目でもな……

key: So talk to the folks over there if you wanna help 'em out!
en: So talk to the folks over there if you wanna help 'em out!
ja: 手を貸したいなら　あそこの連中に　話しかけてくれ!

key: Whatever you do, champ, it's good to have you back!
en: Whatever you do, champ, it's good to have you back!
ja: なにをするにせよ　チャンピオン　戻ってきてくれて　うれしいぜ!

key: Hit me up if you need anything!
en: Hit me up if you need anything!
ja: なにか　あったら　声をかけてくれ!

key: ARC: Hey, Champ!
en: ARC: Hey, Champ!
ja: アーク: よう　チャンピオン!

key: What's this I hear about you capturing Meloetta?
en: What's this I hear about you capturing Meloetta?
ja: メロエッタを　捕まえたって　話は　なんだ?

key: Maaan, I wish I'd been there.
en: Maaan, I wish I'd been there.
ja: うわー　その場に　いたかったぜ

key: ARC: ...
en: ARC: ...

key: Hey, I know now's not the best time,
en: Hey, I know now's not the best time,
ja: なあ　今が　いい時期じゃないのは　分かってる

key: But do you think sometime she'd want to do a show here?
en: But do you think sometime she'd want to do a show here?
ja: だが　いつか　ここで　ライブを　やってくれないかな?

key: It'd liven up the place, and honestly...
en: It'd liven up the place, and honestly...
ja: 店も　盛り上がるし　正直……

key: Collaborating with an artist like that would be a dream.
en: Collaborating with an artist like that would be a dream.
ja: あんなアーティストと　組めたら　夢みたいだ

key: But after things have settled down, for sure.
en: But after things have settled down, for sure.
ja: まあ　落ち着いてからの　話だけどな

key: Maybe float the idea past her?
en: Maybe float the idea past her?
ja: それとなく　聞いてみてくれないか?

key: In the meantime, keep up the good work as always, \PN.
en: In the meantime, keep up the good work as always, \PN.
ja: それまでは　いつもどおり　頼むぜ　\PN

key: ARC: Glad everything went well with the poachers.
en: ARC: Glad everything went well with the poachers.
ja: アーク: 密猟者たちの件が　うまくいって　なによりだ

key: I've got to admit, I wasn't so sure about this at first--
en: I've got to admit, I wasn't so sure about this at first--
ja: 正直　最初は　どうかと　思ってた――

key: Working with Pokémon poachers and all--
en: Working with Pokémon poachers and all--
ja: ポケモンの密猟者と　手を組むなんてな――

key: But I'm glad it worked out well.
en: But I'm glad it worked out well.
ja: でも　うまくいって　よかった

key: I was surprised, actually.
en: I was surprised, actually.
ja: 実を言うと　驚いたよ

key: They seem like a pretty good lot, all things considered.
en: They seem like a pretty good lot, all things considered.
ja: いろいろ考えても　あいつら　なかなか　いい連中だ

key: A few of 'em have even been stopping by to battle it out at the Pavilion.
en: A few of 'em have even been stopping by to battle it out at the Pavilion.
ja: 何人かは　パビリオンに　バトルしに　顔を出してる

key: Just more proof that people can change for the better, I guess.
en: Just more proof that people can change for the better, I guess.
ja: 人は　いい方に　変われるって　証拠だな

key: ARC: Man, when I offered to help out with the band, I wasn't expecting that to happen.
en: ARC: Man, when I offered to help out with the band, I wasn't expecting that to happen.
ja: アーク: いやあ　バンドを　手伝うと　言ったときは　まさか　ああなるとは　思わなかった

key: ...Even without the New World stuff, it's been a bit more than I expected, honestly.
en: ...Even without the New World stuff, it's been a bit more than I expected, honestly.
ja: ……新世界の件を　抜きにしても　正直　思ってたより　大ごとでな

key: They're all working really hard, but between you and me, not one of those kids knows anything about mixing.
en: They're all working really hard, but between you and me, not one of those kids knows anything about mixing.
ja: みんな　必死にやってる。だが　ここだけの話　あの子たち　だれ一人　ミキシングを　分かっちゃいない

key: It's been a lot.
en: It's been a lot.
ja: なかなか　大変だよ

key: I don't mind helping out, but... between running this place, organizing the Anomaly hunts, and the band, I feel like I'm in a bit over my head.
en: I don't mind helping out, but... between running this place, organizing the Anomaly hunts, and the band, I feel like I'm in a bit over my head.
ja: 手伝うのは　かまわないんだが……この店の切り盛りに　アノマリー狩りの　とりまとめ　そのうえ　バンドとなると　さすがに　手に　余ってきた

key: Maybe I'll see about trying to teach Hardy the basics.
en: Maybe I'll see about trying to teach Hardy the basics.
ja: ハーディに　基本を　教えてみるかな

key: He seems like a quick learner when it comes to music, and maybe if he picks up a few things I can stay more in the background.
en: He seems like a quick learner when it comes to music, and maybe if he picks up a few things I can stay more in the background.
ja: 音楽のことなら　のみこみが　早そうだし　いくつか　覚えてくれれば　オレは　もっと　裏に　まわれる

key: Still be there to help out and all, but not have quite so much to do.
en: Still be there to help out and all, but not have quite so much to do.
ja: 手伝いには　行くが　やることは　そこまで　多くなくて済む

key: Ah... Sorry, \PN, I guess I was thinking out loud.
en: Ah... Sorry, \PN, I guess I was thinking out loud.
ja: ああ……悪いな　\PN　つい　考えを　口に出しちまった

key: I'll talk to Hardy about it, don't worry.
en: I'll talk to Hardy about it, don't worry.
ja: ハーディには　オレから　話す。心配するな

key: You just focus on relaxing for a bit.
en: You just focus on relaxing for a bit.
ja: おまえは　しばらく　のんびりすることだけ　考えてろ

key: Arce-- Uh.
en: Arce-- Uh.
ja: アルセ――いや

key: Everyone knows you deserve it.
en: Everyone knows you deserve it.
ja: それくらいの資格は　あるって　みんな　分かってる

key: ARC: How've you been managing it all, Champ?
en: ARC: How've you been managing it all, Champ?
ja: アーク: うまく　やれてるか? チャンピオン

key: Seems like you've been helpin' out with a lot of those Anomalies.
en: Seems like you've been helpin' out with a lot of those Anomalies.
ja: アノマリーの件で　だいぶ　手を貸してくれてるみたいだな

key: I can't say how grateful I am.
en: I can't say how grateful I am.
ja: 感謝しても　しきれない

key: They just keep coming.
en: They just keep coming.
ja: 次から次へと　わいてくる

key: I guess it keeps things from getting boring around here, at least!
en: I guess it keeps things from getting boring around here, at least!
ja: まあ　おかげで　退屈しないのは　確かだけどな!

key: ARC: I won't lie, \PN, this is nice.
en: ARC: I won't lie, \PN, this is nice.
ja: アーク: 正直に言うぜ　\PN　こういうのは　いいもんだ

key: No Anomalies, no one fearing for their lives...
en: No Anomalies, no one fearing for their lives...
ja: アノマリーも　なし。命の心配をする者も　なし……

key: Just some good music.
en: Just some good music.
ja: あるのは　いい音楽だけ

key: Good friends, too.
en: Good friends, too.
ja: いい仲間も　な

key: ...Well, maybe 'friends' is a stretch for some; I know people've had their issues,
en: ...Well, maybe 'friends' is a stretch for some; I know people've had their issues,
ja: ……まあ「仲間」は　言いすぎの相手も　いるか。いろいろ　あった連中も　いるからな

key: And probably still do.
en: And probably still do.
ja: たぶん　今も　あるんだろう

key: But as long as nobody wrecks my club fighting, I'm okay with that.
en: But as long as nobody wrecks my club fighting, I'm okay with that.
ja: だが　ケンカで　店を　こわさないかぎり　オレは　それでいい

key: Means I can start getting back to the music.
en: Means I can start getting back to the music.
ja: そのぶん　音楽に　戻れるからな

key: Thanks again, Champ. For everything.
en: Thanks again, Champ. For everything.
ja: 改めて　ありがとうな　チャンピオン。ぜんぶ　ひっくるめて

key: ARC: Digging the beat?
en: ARC: Digging the beat?
ja: アーク: このビート　いけてるだろ?

key: ARC: Stay strong out there!
en: ARC: Stay strong out there!
ja: アーク: 外でも　気を　しっかりな!

key: ARC: This is the place we come together.
en: ARC: This is the place we come together.
ja: アーク: ここは　みんなが　集まる場所だ

key: To be ourselves, and to be better than just ourselves.
en: To be ourselves, and to be better than just ourselves.
ja: 自分らしくいられて　自分以上に　なれる場所

key: That's why this is my home.
en: That's why this is my home.
ja: だから　ここが　オレの家なんだ

key: ARC: Music makes us more than who we are.
en: ARC: Music makes us more than who we are.
ja: アーク: 音楽は　オレたちを　オレたち以上に　してくれる

key: We're not people, we're vibes.
en: We're not people, we're vibes.
ja: オレたちは　人間じゃない　バイブスだ

key: CAIN: Hey.
en: CAIN: Hey.
ja: カイン: やあ

key: Thanks for helping me out of there, ahaha.
en: Thanks for helping me out of there, ahaha.
ja: あそこから　助け出してくれて　ありがとねぇ　あはは

key: I may be pretty good at gettin' around, but that--
en: I may be pretty good at gettin' around, but that--
ja: ボク　どこにでも　もぐりこむのは　得意なほうだけどさ　あれは――

key: That was a heck of a place to wake up.
en: That was a heck of a place to wake up.
ja: 目を覚ます場所としては　なかなか　とんでもなかったよ～

key: I guess... I've got a lot of things to think about,
en: I guess... I've got a lot of things to think about,
ja: まあ……考えなきゃいけないことは　いろいろ　あるんだけどねぇ

key: But when I got in here and saw everyone?
en: But when I got in here and saw everyone?
ja: でも　ここに来て　みんなの顔を　見たらさ?

key: It felt good.
en: It felt good.
ja: なんか　よかったんだよね

key: So maybe that's a good place to start, right?
en: So maybe that's a good place to start, right?
ja: だから　そこから　始めれば　いいのかも　でしょ?

key: Anyway, this place is awesome!
en: Anyway, this place is awesome!
ja: それにしても　ここ　サイコーだねぇ!

key: I never thought something like this could pop up right in Reborn City!
en: I never thought something like this could pop up right in Reborn City!
ja: こんな場所が　リボーンシティの　ど真ん中に　できるなんて　思わなかったよ～

key: I'm gonna hang around for a bit, catch up with everyone.
en: I'm gonna hang around for a bit, catch up with everyone.
ja: しばらく　ここに　いて　みんなと　積もる話でも　するつもり

key: Apparently there's a whole bunch of those Anomaly things running around?
en: Apparently there's a whole bunch of those Anomaly things running around?
ja: なんか　アノマリーってやつが　そこらじゅうに　いるらしいじゃない?

key: That sounds like it'd be fun to check out.
en: That sounds like it'd be fun to check out.
ja: 見に行ったら　楽しそうだねぇ

key: ...As long as, y'know, I don't get stuck in there again.
en: ...As long as, y'know, I don't get stuck in there again.
ja: ……まあ　また　閉じこめられたり　しなければ　の話だけど

key: But if I do, I'll count on you to rescue me!
en: But if I do, I'll count on you to rescue me!
ja: もし　そうなったら　助けに来てね　たのむよ!

key: Your fair prince!
en: Your fair prince!
ja: キミの　かわいい王子様を　ね!

key: Haha...
en: Haha...
ja: あはは……

key: But seriously, thanks again.
en: But seriously, thanks again.
ja: でも　ほんとに　ありがとう

key: CAIN: Looks like I gotta add dealing with our messed up family to the loooooong list of things I owe you for, huh?
en: CAIN: Looks like I gotta add dealing with our messed up family to the loooooong list of things I owe you for, huh?
ja: カイン: ボクの　ぐちゃぐちゃな家族の件も　キミへの借りの　なが～いリストに　追加だねぇ?

key: Thanks for looking out for Aya.
en: Thanks for looking out for Aya.
ja: アヤのこと　気にかけてくれて　ありがとう

key: I wish I coulda done that better myself, but...
en: I wish I coulda done that better myself, but...
ja: ボクが　もっと　うまくやれたら　よかったんだけどさ……

key: Uh, well, in my defense, I am still the younger sibling.
en: Uh, well, in my defense, I am still the younger sibling.
ja: まあ　言いわけすると　ボク　まだ　弟のほうだからねぇ

key: I don't act like it, I know~
en: I don't act like it, I know~
ja: そう見えないのは　分かってるよ～

key: But my youthful complexion and dulcet tones do not lie to you~
en: But my youthful complexion and dulcet tones do not lie to you~
ja: でも　この　若々しい肌と　甘い声は　うそを　つかないからね～

key: I am still young~
en: I am still young~
ja: ボクは　まだ　若い～

key: Still fertile~
en: Still fertile~
ja: まだ　じゅうぶん　子作りだって　いけるしね～

key: I mean-- what, who said that?
en: I mean-- what, who said that?
ja: って――え　今の　だれが　言ったの?

key: But you know, it's nice to actually have a crew to sing with too.
en: But you know, it's nice to actually have a crew to sing with too.
ja: でもさ　一緒に歌える仲間が　できたのって　いいものだねぇ

ja: ブラックスチームに　向かってくれ　たしか　1階の　大部屋に　集まってるはずだ

key: RINGMASTER: Listen, I think I phrased that badly.
en: RINGMASTER: Listen, I think I phrased that badly.
ja: サーカス団長: いや　今のは　言い方が　まずかったね

key: I just mean to help out when there are inevitably problems...
en: I just mean to help out when there are inevitably problems...
ja: どうせ　問題は　起きるから　そのとき　手を　貸してほしい　って意味だよ……

key: RINGMASTER: Some of the others are rehearsing for a charity show at Blacksteam Shelter.
en: RINGMASTER: Some of the others are rehearsing for a charity show at Blacksteam Shelter.
ja: サーカス団長: 仲間の何人かが　ブラックスチーム避難所で　チャリティー公演の　リハーサルを　してるんだ

key: There's been some inconsistent energy readings for a while, so they want someone else around-- just in case.
en: There's been some inconsistent energy readings for a while, so they want someone else around-- just in case.
ja: 少し前から　エネルギー反応が　不安定でね　念のため　誰かに　そばに　いてほしいそうだ

key: And there will be a case.
en: And there will be a case.
ja: そして　念のためでは　済まないだろうね

key: Cuz, I mean-- that's show business.
en: Cuz, I mean-- that's show business.
ja: だって――それが　ショービジネスって　もんだから

key: Meet up with them in the big room on the first floor of Blacksteam Shelter, but expect the worst!
en: Meet up with them in the big room on the first floor of Blacksteam Shelter, but expect the worst!
ja: ブラックスチーム避難所1階の　大部屋で　合流してくれ　ただし　最悪の事態を　覚悟してね!

key: SIMON: Newest emergency on deck.
en: SIMON: Newest emergency on deck.
ja: サイモン: 新しい緊急案件です

key: You know the meteor?
en: You know the meteor?
ja: 例の　いん石を　知っていますね?

key: As in THE meteor?
en: As in THE meteor?
ja: そう　あの　いん石です

key: It may have been found.
en: It may have been found.
ja: それが　見つかったかも　しれません

key: And where that is, there's a chance Lin is there as well.
en: And where that is, there's a chance Lin is there as well.
ja: そして　それが　ある場所には　リンも　いる可能性が　あります

key: Ciel and Samson have gone to scout it out, but we're rallying more backup if it becomes necessary.
en: Ciel and Samson have gone to scout it out, but we're rallying more backup if it becomes necessary.
ja: シエルと　サムソンが　偵察に　向かいましたが　必要に　なったときのため　増援も　集めています

key: You'd make a good vanguard as always too.
en: You'd make a good vanguard as always too.
ja: あなたなら　いつもどおり　よい先陣に　なるでしょう

key: The meteor was found in a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
en: The meteor was found in a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
ja: いん石が　見つかったのは　シトリン山の中に　ある　新世界のゲートです

key: In case the worst is afoot, it may be best to hurry.
en: In case the worst is afoot, it may be best to hurry.
ja: 最悪の事態が　進んでいるなら　急いだほうが　いいでしょう

key: SIMON: The meteor may have been found.
en: SIMON: The meteor may have been found.
ja: サイモン: いん石が　見つかったかも　しれません

key: Ciel and Samson went to scout it out already, but they could be in desperate need of back up.
en: Ciel and Samson went to scout it out already, but they could be in desperate need of back up.
ja: シエルと　サムソンが　すでに　偵察に　出ていますが　増援を　切実に　求めているかも　しれません

key: It'll be from a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
en: It'll be from a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
ja: 場所は　シトリン山の中の　新世界のゲートです

key: Godspeed.
en: Godspeed.
ja: 武運を　祈ります

key: RANDALL: New shindig, friend. This one comes to you from Beryl Cave.
en: RANDALL: New shindig, friend. This one comes to you from Beryl Cave.
ja: ランドール: 新しい騒ぎだぜ　友よ　今度のは　ベリルどうくつからだ

key: 'Parently there's some kinda temple what appeared over there.
en: 'Parently there's some kinda temple what appeared over there.
ja: なんでも　あそこに　神殿みたいなもんが　現れたらしい

key: Folks are suspectin' there may be another Astronomy in there.
en: Folks are suspectin' there may be another Astronomy in there.
ja: 中に　また　アストロノミーが　いるんじゃねぇかって　みんな　にらんでる

key: A few of the Jim Leaders already went out to give the once over,
en: A few of the Jim Leaders already went out to give the once over,
ja: ジムリーダーってのが　何人か　もう　様子を　見に　行ってる

key: But don't worry, you can call them James Leaders.
en: But don't worry, you can call them James Leaders.
ja: まあ　心配すんな　ジェームズリーダーって　呼んでも　かまわねぇ

key: Reborn James Leaders.
en: Reborn James Leaders.
ja: リボーン・ジェームズリーダーだ

key: Yup, that sounds official.
en: Yup, that sounds official.
ja: うん　いかにも　正式な　感じがするな

key: Anywhoosit, you wanna back 'em up?
en: Anywhoosit, you wanna back 'em up?
ja: ともかく　あいつらの　援護に　行くかい?

key: RANDALL: Radical, friend. You dig those shins.
en: RANDALL: Radical, friend. You dig those shins.
ja: ランドール: いいねぇ　友よ　話が　わかるじゃねぇか

key: Beryl Cave, same Beryl as in Beryl Ward, ya heard it?
en: Beryl Cave, same Beryl as in Beryl Ward, ya heard it?
ja: ベリルどうくつだぞ　ベリルワードの　ベリルと　同じやつだ　聞いたか?

key: Yeah, I'm sure James Reborn has it covered,
en: Yeah, I'm sure James Reborn has it covered,
ja: ああ　ジェームズ・リボーンが　なんとかしてくれるだろうよ

key: Whoever he is.
en: Whoever he is.
ja: そいつが　誰かは　知らんがな

key: RANDALL: Gotta go meet James Reborn over at Beryl Cave.
en: RANDALL: Gotta go meet James Reborn over at Beryl Cave.
ja: ランドール: ベリルどうくつで　ジェームズ・リボーンと　落ち合ってくれ

key: Some kinda temple, they say.
en: Some kinda temple, they say.
ja: 神殿みたいなもんが　あるって話だ

key: MARCELLO: Hi, want to buy some lemonade?
en: MARCELLO: Hi, want to buy some lemonade?
ja: マルチェロ: やあ　レモネード　買う?

key: MARCELLO: Anyway, there's a thing in the desert.
en: MARCELLO: Anyway, there's a thing in the desert.
ja: マルチェロ: ところで　砂漠に　なんか　いるんだ

key: We don't sell directions here.
en: We don't sell directions here.
ja: ここでは　道案内は　売ってないよ

key: But if we did, I'd tell you to take the train from Grandview station, and then follow the tracks north until they disappear.
en: But if we did, I'd tell you to take the train from Grandview station, and then follow the tracks north until they disappear.
ja: でも　もし　売ってたら　グランドビュー駅から　電車に　乗って　線路が　消えるまで　北へ　たどれって　言うね

key: Then move right until you find the door.
en: Then move right until you find the door.
ja: それから　ドアが　見つかるまで　右へ　進むんだ

key: And then I'd tell you to fix it!
en: And then I'd tell you to fix it!
ja: そして　それを　直してこいって　言うよ!

key: MARCELLO: There's a thing in the desert.
en: MARCELLO: There's a thing in the desert.
ja: マルチェロ: 砂漠に　なんか　いるんだ

key: Like the middle of the desert.
en: Like the middle of the desert.
ja: 砂漠の　まんなかへんに

key: And a little bit to the right.
en: And a little bit to the right.
ja: で　ちょっとだけ　右

key: No, I can't be more specific.
en: No, I can't be more specific.
ja: だめ　それ以上　くわしくは　言えない

key: Just fix it.
en: Just fix it.
ja: とにかく　直してきて

key: It's driving away the customers, so go fix it.
en: It's driving away the customers, so go fix it.
ja: お客さんが　来なくなるから　早く　直してきて

key: MARCELLO: The rainbow menace went to the desert!
en: MARCELLO: The rainbow menace went to the desert!
ja: マルチェロ: 虹色の　やっかいものが　砂漠に　行っちゃった!

key: This happened because you didn't fix it!
en: This happened because you didn't fix it!
ja: キミが　直さなかったから　こうなったんだ!

key: There was a thing in the desert and I asked you to fix it and you didn't fix it.
en: There was a thing in the desert and I asked you to fix it and you didn't fix it.
ja: 砂漠に　なんか　いて　直してって　頼んだのに　キミは　直さなかった

key: Go fix it and also fix the rainbow menace!
en: Go fix it and also fix the rainbow menace!
ja: 行って　直してきて　虹色の　やっかいものも　直して!

key: Also buy some lemonade!!!
en: Also buy some lemonade!!!
ja: あと　レモネードも　買って!!!

key: ACE: So this is where all you little heroes have been camping out in all this time!
en: ACE: So this is where all you little heroes have been camping out in all this time!
ja: エース: 小さな英雄さんたちは　ずっと　ここに　たむろして　いたのですね!

key: I've got to say, I quite enjoy the spectacle!
en: I've got to say, I quite enjoy the spectacle!
ja: いやはや　この見せ物　なかなか　楽しませて　もらっていますよ!

key: Where all life is but a precession of stimulation, a bit of smoke and mirrors do a lot to light up our nights!
en: Where all life is but a precession of stimulation, a bit of smoke and mirrors do a lot to light up our nights!
ja: 人生が　刺激の　行進に　すぎないのなら　ひとつまみの　まやかしが　夜を　ずいぶん　明るく　してくれるものです!

key: If what all we know is constrained solely to our experiences, then is illusion truly delusion,
en: If what all we know is constrained solely to our experiences, then is illusion truly delusion,
ja: 私たちの知るすべてが　経験だけに　しばられているのなら　幻とは　本当に　まどわしなのでしょうか

key: Or was it just a memory made special for us?
en: Or was it just a memory made special for us?
ja: それとも　私たちのために　特別に　作られた　思い出　なのでしょうか?

key: Make some fine memories, little hero!
en: Make some fine memories, little hero!
ja: よい思い出を　お作りなさい　小さな英雄さん!

key: Some days, they're all we have.
en: Some days, they're all we have.
ja: 思い出しか　残らない日も　あるのですから

key: ACE: Ah-- \PN, a moment of your time.
en: ACE: Ah-- \PN, a moment of your time.
ja: エース: ああ――\PN　少し　お時間を

key: Back at that awfully chilly New World--
en: Back at that awfully chilly New World--
ja: あの　ひどく冷えきった　新世界での　ことですが――

key: Certainly a rather... frigid and unpleasant place to wake up in my own right mind to.
en: Certainly a rather... frigid and unpleasant place to wake up in my own right mind to.
ja: 正気を　取り戻して　目を覚ますには　まったく……凍てついた　不愉快な　場所でした

key: But perhaps, it is the company I kept that made the spectacle all the more tolerable.
en: But perhaps, it is the company I kept that made the spectacle all the more tolerable.
ja: ですが　あの見せ物に　耐えられたのは　ともに　いてくれた方々の　おかげ　なのでしょうね

key: I hadn't the chance before to express my thanks truly and properly for rescuing me from that predicament of its own.
en: I hadn't the chance before to express my thanks truly and properly for rescuing me from that predicament of its own.
ja: あの窮地から　救い出して　いただいたことに　きちんと　礼を　述べる機会が　これまで　ありませんでした

key: It is admittedly still difficult to remember all the details before I came to.
en: It is admittedly still difficult to remember all the details before I came to.
ja: 正直に　言えば　我に返る前のことは　いまだに　思い出しにくいのです

key: Ah, but why dwell on matters out of our own hands?
en: Ah, but why dwell on matters out of our own hands?
ja: ああ　しかし　手の届かぬことに　こだわっても　仕方が　ありませんね?

key: I'd simply wanted to find the time to thank you from the bottom of my heart for rescuing the little prince as you did.
en: I'd simply wanted to find the time to thank you from the bottom of my heart for rescuing the little prince as you did.
ja: ただ　あの小さな王子を　あなたが　救ってくださったことに　心の底から　礼を　言いたかった　それだけです

key: I had enough lucidity at the start from the box I was in to save ZEL from Magnezone's explosion, but--
en: I had enough lucidity at the start from the box I was in to save ZEL from Magnezone's explosion, but--
ja: あの箱の中に　いたころは　まだ　いくらか　正気が　残っていて　ジバコイルの爆発から　ゼルを　救うことは　できました　ですが――

key: I-- I-I'd never quite lived out my own nightmares in reality as I did when I bore witness to his fate in that Steel Leader's Gym, and...
en: I-- I-I'd never quite lived out my own nightmares in reality as I did when I bore witness to his fate in that Steel Leader's Gym, and...
ja: わ――私は　あの　はがねのリーダーの　ジムで　彼の　行く末を　目にしたときほど　自分の悪夢を　現実に　生きたことは　ありません　そして……

key: ACE: ...Well, all I can say is that I have never been more grateful as I am now.
en: ACE: ...Well, all I can say is that I have never been more grateful as I am now.
ja: エース: ……ともあれ　今ほど　感謝の念に　満たされたことは　ないと　それだけは　言えます

key: ...For you, and for his safe return.
en: ...For you, and for his safe return.
ja: ……あなたに　そして　彼が　無事に　戻ったことに

key: ACE: Trouble with a disappearing dragon, was there?
en: ACE: Trouble with a disappearing dragon, was there?
ja: エース: 消えるドラゴンで　ひと騒動　ありましたね?

key: You know, I always did think it was a bit queer,
en: You know, I always did think it was a bit queer,
ja: 実は　前々から　少し　妙だと　思っていたのです

key: The wasteland packed more whimsy and pizzazz than you could punt a whiffle at.
en: The wasteland packed more whimsy and pizzazz than you could punt a whiffle at.
ja: あの荒地には　数えきれないほどの　気まぐれと　華やかさが　詰まっていましたから

key: Why would that be?
en: Why would that be?
ja: なぜ　なのでしょう?

key: Some kind of Legendary force just living out there?
en: Some kind of Legendary force just living out there?
ja: 伝説の　力が　あそこに　住みついていた　とか?

key: Something real that no one could see?
en: Something real that no one could see?
ja: 誰にも　見えない　本物が　そこに　あった　とか?

key: Things like that-- they're always in such a way that someone must be trying very hard to keep them hidden.
en: Things like that-- they're always in such a way that someone must be trying very hard to keep them hidden.
ja: そういうものは――決まって　誰かが　必死に　隠そうと　しているものです

key: It is perhaps surprising that someone of my persuasions didn't see through the ruse sooner!
en: It is perhaps surprising that someone of my persuasions didn't see through the ruse sooner!
ja: 私のように　手品を　なりわいと　する者が　もっと早く　その仕掛けを　見破れなかったとは　我ながら　驚きです!

key: Ah, but if we could see all of life's illusions with just a glance, then what would be the point of looking at all?
en: Ah, but if we could see all of life's illusions with just a glance, then what would be the point of looking at all?
ja: ああ　しかし　人生の幻を　ひと目で　すべて　見抜けるなら　そもそも　見ることに　何の意味が　あるでしょう?

key: It does this performer a spot of good to be outmaneuvered!
en: It does this performer a spot of good to be outmaneuvered!
ja: 出し抜かれるのも　芸人には　いい薬なのです!

key: Still, all for the best for you to still the beast.
en: Still, all for the best for you to still the beast.
ja: それでも　あなたが　あの獣を　鎮めたのは　最良の結末でした

key: And don't bother asking something silly like how I would know what happened.
en: And don't bother asking something silly like how I would know what happened.
ja: それと　なぜ私が　何があったのかを　知っているのか　などと　野暮なことは　聞かないで　くださいね

key: Didn't I ever tell you?
en: Didn't I ever tell you?
ja: お伝えして　いませんでしたか?

key: I can read minds, you know!
en: I can read minds, you know!
ja: 私は　心が　読めるのですよ!

key: ACE: Still finding all those antagonistic Anomalies out there, are you?
en: ACE: Still finding all those antagonistic Anomalies out there, are you?
ja: エース: あの　やっかいな　アノマリーたちを　まだ　見つけて回っているのですね?

key: I've heard quite magnificent tales of all the magic you've mustered on your journey!
en: I've heard quite magnificent tales of all the magic you've mustered on your journey!
ja: あなたが　旅の中で　起こしてきた　魔法の　見事な話は　いくつも　耳に　しています!

key: Ah, you needn't be shy about it, little hero!
en: Ah, you needn't be shy about it, little hero!
ja: ああ　照れることは　ありませんよ　小さな英雄さん!

key: Why, what's the gain of embarrassment?
en: Why, what's the gain of embarrassment?
ja: 恥ずかしがって　何か　得が　ありますか?

key: Only to dim a spectacular show!
en: Only to dim a spectacular show!
ja: すばらしい舞台を　くすませるだけです!

key: You've committed an admirable amount of splendor amongst all your adventures-- but even then, what is any adventure but another stepping stone to the stars?
en: You've committed an admirable amount of splendor amongst all your adventures-- but even then, what is any adventure but another stepping stone to the stars?
ja: あなたは　その冒険の中で　見事なまでの　輝きを　残してきました――とはいえ　冒険とは　星へ向かう　次の一歩に　ほかならないでしょう?

key: Let yourself shine-- the stars will thank you themselves, to see another among them!
en: Let yourself shine-- the stars will thank you themselves, to see another among them!
ja: 思うぞんぶん　輝きなさい――仲間が　増えたと　星たちのほうから　あなたに　礼を　言うでしょう!

key: ACE: By the by, I understand you picked up a little friend down in the Water Treatment Center!
en: ACE: By the by, I understand you picked up a little friend down in the Water Treatment Center!
ja: エース: ところで　浄水センターで　小さな友を　迎えたそうですね!

key: And I know you won't do something silly like ask how I know that!
en: And I know you won't do something silly like ask how I know that!
ja: なぜ　それを　知っているのかなどと　野暮なことは　聞かないと　わかっていますよ!

key: I was perhaps, wondering...
en: I was perhaps, wondering...
ja: そこで　ひとつ　思ったのですが……

key: May I see the little one?
en: May I see the little one?
ja: あの子に　会わせて　いただけますか?

key: ACE: ...Hm? That doesn't seem to be the little one I remember...
en: ACE: ...Hm? That doesn't seem to be the little one I remember...
ja: エース: ……おや? 私の覚えている　あの子とは　ちがうようですが……

key: ACE: You're still quite small, aren't you, little one?
en: ACE: You're still quite small, aren't you, little one?
ja: エース: まだ　ずいぶん　小さいのですね　おちびさん

key: ACE: You're growing stronger under \PN's care, aren't you?
en: ACE: You're growing stronger under \PN's care, aren't you?
ja: エース: \PNのもとで　強く　なっているのですね

key: ACE: Ah, you're all grown up, little one!
en: ACE: Ah, you're all grown up, little one!
ja: エース: ああ　すっかり　大きくなりましたね　おちびさん!

key: I'd missed seeing you dearly.
en: I'd missed seeing you dearly.
ja: 会えなくて　寂しかったのですよ

key: It was a bit of a rushed job, you see-- the circumstances hadn't exactly permitted me any different.
en: It was a bit of a rushed job, you see-- the circumstances hadn't exactly permitted me any different.
ja: あのときは　少々　急ごしらえで　ね――ああするより　ほかに　なかったのです

key: I'd hoped that it wouldn't be too lonely in there.
en: I'd hoped that it wouldn't be too lonely in there.
ja: あの中が　あまり　寂しくなければ　いいと　願っていました

key: ...Perhaps you and I aren't so different in that regard, hm, little one?
en: ...Perhaps you and I aren't so different in that regard, hm, little one?
ja: ……その点では　あなたと私も　似た者どうしなのかも　しれませんね　おちびさん?

key: I count myself grateful that you're in more than capable hands now.
en: I count myself grateful that you're in more than capable hands now.
ja: 今は　これ以上ない　頼もしい手に　ゆだねられていて　ありがたい　かぎりです

key: And to you, \PN--
en: And to you, \PN--
ja: そして　\PN　あなたにも――

key: ACE: You may consider your debt of paying it forward as fully imbursed already!
en: ACE: You may consider your debt of paying it forward as fully imbursed already!
ja: エース: 恩送りの　借りなら　もう　すっかり　返し終えていますよ!

key: If this little one helped you step forward at any part of your journey between saving the world and freeing me, then it is a miracle play in my book!
en: If this little one helped you step forward at any part of your journey between saving the world and freeing me, then it is a miracle play in my book!
ja: 世界を救い　私を解き放つまでの　旅のどこかで　この子が　あなたの　一歩を　支えたのなら　それは　私にとって　奇跡の舞台そのものです!

key: And if it didn't...
en: And if it didn't...
ja: もし　そうでなかったなら……

key: Well, no accounting for taste, I suppose!
en: Well, no accounting for taste, I suppose!
ja: まあ　好みは　人それぞれ　ですね!

key: Do take care of each other anyway, won't you?
en: Do take care of each other anyway, won't you?
ja: なんにせよ　互いを　大切に　してくださいね?

key: ACE: Ah, understandably so.
en: ACE: Ah, understandably so.
ja: エース: ああ　もっともなことです

key: Perhaps I could ask another time.
en: Perhaps I could ask another time.
ja: また　いずれ　お願いすると　しましょう

key: ACE: Pick a card, any card!
en: ACE: Pick a card, any card!
ja: エース: カードを　1枚　どれでも　お選びなさい!

key: Ah, of course!
en: Ah, of course!
ja: ああ　やはり!

key: I knew you'd pick the 'Yes' card!
en: I knew you'd pick the 'Yes' card!
ja: あなたが　『はい』のカードを　選ぶと　わかっていました!

key: I knew you'd pick the 'No' card!
en: I knew you'd pick the 'No' card!
ja: あなたが　『いいえ』のカードを　選ぶと　わかっていました!

key: It was written all over your face.
en: It was written all over your face.
ja: 顔に　しっかり　書いてありましたよ

key: Now I'll simply spin it around twice like so, and--
en: Now I'll simply spin it around twice like so, and--
