key: "human go help door in stinky water place below city!"
en: "human go help door in stinky water place below city!"
ja: 「人間 行く助ける扉 くさい水場所 街の下!」

key: "human go help door in stinky wet place below city!"
en: "human go help door in stinky wet place below city!"
ja: 「街の下のくさい水場所にある扉を人間が行って助ける!」

key: SANDY: We've got a new report from the good folks out at Train Town!
en: SANDY: We've got a new report from the good folks out at Train Town!
ja: サンディ: トレインタウンのいい人たちから、新しい報告が届いたよ!

key: Apparently one of those folks was out on a hike at Teknite Ridge and saw one of those New World doors!
en: Apparently one of those folks was out on a hike at Teknite Ridge and saw one of those New World doors!
ja: どうやら、その中の一人がテクナイト尾根をハイキング中に、あの新世界の扉の一つを見たんだって!

key: It was pretty high up, so you might need to take a solid stroll through the mountains to reach it,
en: It was pretty high up, so you might need to take a solid stroll through the mountains to reach it,
ja: 結構高いところにあったから、そこまで行くにはしっかり山道を歩く必要があるかもしれないけど、

key: But it'd be best for someone to get up there and give it the check before something bad happens!
en: But it'd be best for someone to get up there and give it the check before something bad happens!
ja: 何か悪いことが起きる前に、誰かが行って確認した方がいいと思うんだ!

key: I wonder what it'll be this time...
en: I wonder what it'll be this time...
ja: 今回は何が出るのかな……

key: Giratina? Rayquaza? Necrozma?!
en: Giratina? Rayquaza? Necrozma?!
ja: ギラティナ? レックウザ? ネクロズマ?!

key: What do you think, \PN?
en: What do you think, \PN?
ja: どう思う、\PN?

key: Think I could rock a Necrozma?
en: Think I could rock a Necrozma?
ja: あたしにネクロズマって似合うと思う?

key: It's not exactly my style, but who cares?!
en: It's not exactly my style, but who cares?!
ja: あたしの趣味とは全然違うけど、まあいいや!

key: Maybe I'll try going back to field work long enough to find one...
en: Maybe I'll try going back to field work long enough to find one...
ja: 久しぶりにフィールドワークに戻って、それ見つけに行こうかな……

key: RINGMASTER: Hey, I don't suppose I could ask you for a favor...
en: RINGMASTER: Hey, I don't suppose I could ask you for a favor...
ja: リングマスター: ねえ、頼み事があるんだけど……

key: This doesn't actually have anything to do with hunting Legendaries, but we've been trying to get someone to look into this--
en: This doesn't actually have anything to do with hunting Legendaries, but we've been trying to get someone to look into this--
ja: これは伝説ポケモン狩りとは全然関係ないんだけど、誰かに調べてもらおうとしてたことがあってね――

key: Apparently a suspicious individual has been haunting the Battle Pavilion lately?
en: Apparently a suspicious individual has been haunting the Battle Pavilion lately?
ja: 最近、バトルパビリオンに不審な人物が出没してるらしいんだ?

key: He keeps sweeping it clean, making weird noises and then disappearing.
en: He keeps sweeping it clean, making weird noises and then disappearing.
ja: そこをずっと掃除しては、変な音を立てて、それから消えていくんだよ。

key: I don't suppose you could go have a word with him?
en: I don't suppose you could go have a word with him?
ja: その人に一言、話しに行ってもらえないかな?

key: As the Champion, I can't think of a better person to root him out from there.
en: As the Champion, I can't think of a better person to root him out from there.
ja: チャンピオンのあなたほど、そこから追い出すのにぴったりな人はいないと思うんだ。

key: RINGMASTER: Oh, lovely.
en: RINGMASTER: Oh, lovely.
ja: リングマスター: ああ、よかった。

key: Good, because the whole ordeal was really starting to creep me out.
en: Good, because the whole ordeal was really starting to creep me out.
ja: 助かるよ、正直、その件はもうかなり不気味に感じ始めてたから。

key: He's been seen frequently in the Singles Battle Pavilion circuit.
en: He's been seen frequently in the Singles Battle Pavilion circuit.
ja: その人物は、シングルバトルパビリオンの区画で頻繁に目撃されてるよ。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張ってね!

key: RINGMASTER: I suppose proper Legendaries take priority...
en: RINGMASTER: I suppose proper Legendaries take priority...
ja: リングマスター: 本物の伝説ポケモンの方が優先だよね……

key: That's fine-- that's fine! I'm sure we have an understudy somewhere.
en: That's fine-- that's fine! I'm sure we have an understudy somewhere.
ja: 大丈夫、大丈夫! 代役なら誰かいるはずだから。

key: RINGMASTER: Apparently a suspicious individual has been haunting the Battle Pavilion lately?
en: RINGMASTER: Apparently a suspicious individual has been haunting the Battle Pavilion lately?
ja: リングマスター: 最近、バトルパビリオンに不審な人物が出没してるらしいんだ?

key: RINGMASTER: Ahahah...?
en: RINGMASTER: Ahahah...?
ja: リングマスター: あはは……?

key: The suspicious person was a Mewtwo in disguise...?
en: The suspicious person was a Mewtwo in disguise...?
ja: その不審な人物は、変装したミュウツーだったの……?

key: What would a Mewtwo be doing here?!
en: What would a Mewtwo be doing here?!
ja: ミュウツーがここで一体何をしてたのよ?!

key: Scratch that-- who even let it into the Battle Pavilion???
en: Scratch that-- who even let it into the Battle Pavilion???
ja: いや、それより――そもそも誰がそいつをバトルパビリオンに入れたわけ???

key: I didn't realize the attendant running it was one of the clowns from my circus!
en: I didn't realize the attendant running it was one of the clowns from my circus!
ja: それを担当してた係員が、うちのサーカスのピエロの一人だったなんて、思ってもみなかったわ!

key: ...Okay, it's fine-- everything's fine.
en: ...Okay, it's fine-- everything's fine.
ja: ……まあいいわ、大丈夫、全部大丈夫。

key: Well, I guess now this really is a job for you.
en: Well, I guess now this really is a job for you.
ja: さて、これはもう本当にあなたの仕事になっちゃったみたいね。

key: Around the same time that that Mewtwo flew on out of here-- I haven't even asked about the repair costs, and I don't want to-- we got a new reading.
en: Around the same time that that Mewtwo flew on out of here-- I haven't even asked about the repair costs, and I don't want to-- we got a new reading.
ja: そのミュウツーがここから飛び去っていったのと同じ頃――修理費のことはまだ聞いてないし、聞きたくもないんだけど――新しい反応が出たの。

key: It looks like another New World door has appeared; this one from somewhere deep under Tanzan Mountain.
en: It looks like another New World door has appeared; this one from somewhere deep under Tanzan Mountain.
ja: どうやら、別の新世界の扉が出現したみたい。今回はタンザン山の奥深くから。

key: You know what to do, right?
en: You know what to do, right?
ja: 何をすればいいか、わかってるわよね?

key: RINGMASTER: It looks like another New World door has appeared; this one from somewhere deep under Tanzan Mountain.
en: RINGMASTER: It looks like another New World door has appeared; this one from somewhere deep under Tanzan Mountain.
ja: リングマスター: どうやら、別の新世界の扉が出現したみたい。今回はタンザン山の奥深くから。

key: SEACREST: Well, hello there!
en: SEACREST: Well, hello there!
ja: シークレスト: おやおや、こんにちは!

key: I thought I might take some time off from my gardening to help you spritely young folks out.
en: I thought I might take some time off from my gardening to help you spritely young folks out.
ja: 庭仕事の手を少し休めて、あんたたち元気な若者を手伝おうと思ってね。

key: Adrienn sure seems to have had quite the trouble with everything lately...
en: Adrienn sure seems to have had quite the trouble with everything lately...
ja: アドリエンヌ、最近すっかり色々大変そうだねえ……

key: Ohoho, as if running a whole city wouldn't do that!
en: Ohoho, as if running a whole city wouldn't do that!
ja: おほほ、街全体を運営してればそうもなるだろうさ!

key: I've had my hands full just with my own garden for years.
en: I've had my hands full just with my own garden for years.
ja: わしなんて、自分の庭一つで何年も手一杯だったよ。

key: Xe'll learn to think small one day,
en: Xe'll learn to think small one day,
ja: あの人もいつか、小さく考えることを覚えるだろうがね、

key: But until then, let's see what we can't get done, eh?
en: But until then, let's see what we can't get done, eh?
ja: それまでは、わしらにできることを見てみようじゃないか、なあ?

key: There's been some hearsay of Legendary Pokémon flitting about Azurine Lake for quite some time now...
en: There's been some hearsay of Legendary Pokémon flitting about Azurine Lake for quite some time now...
ja: もうかなり前から、アズリン湖のあたりを伝説のポケモンが飛び回ってるってうわさがあってな……

key: Now, I don't quite have the full grasp of all this 'New World' stuff,
en: Now, I don't quite have the full grasp of all this 'New World' stuff,
ja: この「新世界」とやらのことは、わしにはあまりよくわかっとらんが、

key: But the other said I'm supposed to mention that the, erm, door that these Pokémon emerged from has likely already closed.
en: But the other said I'm supposed to mention that the, erm, door that these Pokémon emerged from has likely already closed.
ja: もう一人が言うには、そのポケモンたちが出てきた扉は、もう閉じてる可能性が高いって伝えるようにってさ。

key: Meaning there won't be an Anomaly,
en: Meaning there won't be an Anomaly,
ja: つまり、アノマリーにはならないってことじゃな、

key: So they say.
en: So they say.
ja: らしいよ。

key: If you ask me though, Legendary Pokémon sound like an anomaly any day!
en: If you ask me though, Legendary Pokémon sound like an anomaly any day!
ja: まあ、わしに言わせりゃ、伝説のポケモンってだけでいつでも十分アノマリーだと思うがね!

key: Maybe not so much now though, hm?
en: Maybe not so much now though, hm?
ja: もっとも、今はそうでもないかもしれんが、な?

key: Anyway, if I've got it right, you're just looking for the Pokémon themselves in the Lake, not a door this time.
en: Anyway, if I've got it right, you're just looking for the Pokémon themselves in the Lake, not a door this time.
ja: とにかく、わしの理解が正しければ、今回は扉じゃなくて、湖のポケモンそのものを探せばいいってことじゃ。

key: From our reports, there's one on the water's surface, one underwater, and one in a cave!
en: From our reports, there's one on the water's surface, one underwater, and one in a cave!
ja: 報告によると、水面に一体、水中に一体、洞窟に一体いるらしい!

key: Best of luck, little champion!
en: Best of luck, little champion!
ja: 頑張るんじゃぞ、小さなチャンピオンよ!

key: SEACREST: There's been some hearsay of Legendary Pokémon flitting about Azurine Lake for quite some time now...
en: SEACREST: There's been some hearsay of Legendary Pokémon flitting about Azurine Lake for quite some time now...
ja: シークレスト: もうかなり前から、アズリン湖のあたりを伝説のポケモンが飛び回ってるってうわさがあってな……

key: SEACREST: Greetings, Champion!
en: SEACREST: Greetings, Champion!
ja: シークレスト: ようこそ、チャンピオン!

key: The others are out monitoring for more Anomaly reports, but we've got one thing on the docket as is.
en: The others are out monitoring for more Anomaly reports, but we've got one thing on the docket as is.
ja: 他の者たちは他のアノマリー報告の監視に出とるが、今のところこの一件があるんじゃ。

key: According to a recent report, Vanhanen Castle might be haunted!
en: According to a recent report, Vanhanen Castle might be haunted!
ja: 最近の報告によると、ヴァンハネン城が幽霊屋敷になっとるかもしれん!

key: Weren't you only just deployed there?
en: Weren't you only just deployed there?
ja: あんた、つい最近そこに派遣されたばかりじゃなかったかね?

key: But someone reported hearing strange noises coming from inside.
en: But someone reported hearing strange noises coming from inside.
ja: だが、中から奇妙な音が聞こえたって報告があってな。

key: When they went to take a peek, they swear they could just barely see through the darkness--
en: When they went to take a peek, they swear they could just barely see through the darkness--
ja: のぞきに行った者は、暗闇の中でかろうじて見えたと誓って言うんじゃ――

key: A ghostly, young girl with her hair tied up in pigtails...
en: A ghostly, young girl with her hair tied up in pigtails...
ja: ツインテールに髪を結んだ、幽霊のような若い少女……

key: But as soon as they blinked, she vanished!
en: But as soon as they blinked, she vanished!
ja: だが瞬きした瞬間、その子は消えてしまったと!

key: And yet we've gotten an anonymous tip that some kind of Anomaly or legendary has sprung up residence within its halls again.
en: And yet we've gotten an anonymous tip that some kind of Anomaly or legendary has sprung up residence within its halls again.
ja: それでも、また何らかのアノマリーか伝説のポケモンがその廊下に住み着いたっていう匿名の情報が入っとる。

key: A pale, ghostly shape billows through its halls, all but vanishing once seen.
en: A pale, ghostly shape billows through its halls, all but vanishing once seen.
ja: 青白い、幽霊のような姿が廊下を漂って、見た瞬間にほぼ消えてしまうと。

key: Near the arena, they said.
en: Near the arena, they said.
ja: アリーナの近くだそうじゃ。

key: Will you investigate?
en: Will you investigate?
ja: 調査してくれるかね?

key: SEACREST: No better fellow for it!
en: SEACREST: No better fellow for it!
ja: シークレスト: これ以上ふさわしい人物はおらんよ!

key: Godspeed you, champion.
en: Godspeed you, champion.
ja: 武運を祈っとるぞ、チャンピオン。

key: To the Vanhanen Arena!
en: To the Vanhanen Arena!
ja: ヴァンハネンのアリーナへ!

key: Hohoho, what's the matter?
en: Hohoho, what's the matter?
ja: ほほほ、どうしたんじゃ?

key: Could it be that our daring champion is a mite afeared of ghosts?
en: Could it be that our daring champion is a mite afeared of ghosts?
ja: もしや、我らが勇敢なチャンピオンも、幽霊が少し怖いのかな?

key: I'll be sure to keep that one in my back pocket!
en: I'll be sure to keep that one in my back pocket!
ja: それは、いつか使えるネタとして取っておかんとな!

key: SEACREST: There's been reports of the haunting of Vanhanen Castle.
en: SEACREST: There's been reports of the haunting of Vanhanen Castle.
ja: シークレスト: ヴァンハネン城の幽霊騒ぎの報告が入っとる。

key: Some kind of figure teeters in this realm near the arena!
en: Some kind of figure teeters in this realm near the arena!
ja: アリーナの近く、何らかの姿がこの現実の中でよろめいとるらしい!

key: Best you put your fears behind you and go see it!
en: Best you put your fears behind you and go see it!
ja: 恐怖心は置いといて、見に行くのがよかろうよ!

key: ARCHER: A refresher for our greatest ace?
en: ARCHER: A refresher for our greatest ace?
ja: アーチャー: 我らが最強のエースに、確認だな?

key: ARCHER: Well met again, \PN.
en: ARCHER: Well met again, \PN.
ja: アーチャー: またお会いしましたね、\PN。

key: I heard you've been on quite the adventure since you've been out.
en: I heard you've been on quite the adventure since you've been out.
ja: 離れていた間、なかなかの冒険をしていたと聞きました。

key: I've had my own business to attend to, as you're no doubt well aware, but nevertheless, I find it imperative to chip in here as well.
en: I've had my own business to attend to, as you're no doubt well aware, but nevertheless, I find it imperative to chip in here as well.
ja: 私にも自分の用事がありましたが、あなたもご存知の通り、それでもここで一役買うことが不可欠だと考えています。

key: After all, we are still attending to the needs of our community as best we can here.
en: After all, we are still attending to the needs of our community as best we can here.
ja: 結局のところ、私たちはここで、できる限りこの地域社会の要求に応え続けています。

key: You too, then, as usual.
en: You too, then, as usual.
ja: あなたも、いつも通り、というわけですね。

key: Let's get to it.
en: Let's get to it.
ja: では、始めましょう。

key: A handful of reports have come in from the Chrysolia region reporting a large amount of steam pouring out from somewhere near the forest.
en: A handful of reports have come in from the Chrysolia region reporting a large amount of steam pouring out from somewhere near the forest.
ja: クリソリア地方から、森の近くのどこかから大量の蒸気が吹き出しているという報告がいくつか届いています。

key: It's likely another legendary, though no reports of a New World door have come in recently so if there was one, it may have already closed.
en: It's likely another legendary, though no reports of a New World door have come in recently so if there was one, it may have already closed.
ja: おそらくまた伝説のポケモンでしょうが、最近は新世界の扉の報告はないので、もしあったとしても、すでに閉じている可能性があります。

key: As usual, get in, get it done, get back.
en: As usual, get in, get it done, get back.
ja: いつも通り、突入し、片付け、戻る。

key: We'll be on standby, should you require support.
en: We'll be on standby, should you require support.
ja: 支援が必要であれば、待機しています。

key: MAXWELL: Need a reminder?
en: MAXWELL: Need a reminder?
ja: マクスウェル: 確認いるか?

key: MAXWELL: \PN! Good to see you again!
en: MAXWELL: \PN! Good to see you again!
ja: マクスウェル: \PN! また会えたな!

key: A birdie told me you dipped out for a while, and while I can't say I don't understand the need for time off, I was disappointed anyway.
en: A birdie told me you dipped out for a while, and while I can't say I don't understand the need for time off, I was disappointed anyway.
ja: しばらく姿を消してたってうわさで聞いたぜ、休みが必要ってのはわからなくもねえけど、正直がっかりしたんだよな。

key: But here you are, back and at it with me!
en: But here you are, back and at it with me!
ja: でも戻ってきて、また一緒にやってくれるってわけだ!

key: Legendaries are out there stirrin' shit again.
en: Legendaries are out there stirrin' shit again.
ja: 伝説のやつらがまたそこらで暴れてるぜ。

key: Who's gonna fix it if we don't?
en: Who's gonna fix it if we don't?
ja: 俺たちがやらなきゃ、誰がなんとかすんだよ?

key: You're with me, right?
en: You're with me, right?
ja: 一緒にやってくれるよな?

key: We got some reports coming in from Chrysolia of huge amounts of steam pouring out from somewhere near the forest.
en: We got some reports coming in from Chrysolia of huge amounts of steam pouring out from somewhere near the forest.
ja: クリソリアから、森の近くのどこかから大量の蒸気が吹き出してるって報告がいくつか来てるぜ。

key: No New World Door, no sightings-- just lots of steam.
en: No New World Door, no sightings-- just lots of steam.
ja: 新世界の扉もなし、目撃情報もなし――ただ蒸気がすごいだけ。

key: The people are concerned.
en: The people are concerned.
ja: 住民たちも心配してる。

key: We gotta check it out.
en: We gotta check it out.
ja: 確認しに行かねえとな。

key: It's probably a legendary hiding somewhere. May or may not be a New World portal with it.
en: It's probably a legendary hiding somewhere. May or may not be a New World portal with it.
ja: 多分どっかに伝説のやつが隠れてんだろ。新世界の入口があるかどうかはわかんねえけど。

key: Just a typical search and destroy.
en: Just a typical search and destroy.
ja: いつも通りの捜索と排除だ。

key: For glory, baby!
en: For glory, baby!
ja: 栄光のためにな、ベイビー!

key: SEACREST: Greetings again!
en: SEACREST: Greetings again!
ja: シークレスト: また会ったな!

key: We've got new reports of an Anomaly world that's appeared deep within Victory Road.
en: We've got new reports of an Anomaly world that's appeared deep within Victory Road.
ja: チャンピオンロードの奥深くに、アノマリーの世界が出現したっていう新しい報告があるぞ。

key: It was an old miner who discovered these!
en: It was an old miner who discovered these!
ja: 見つけたのは、年老いた鉱夫じゃった!

key: Out surveying his old working grounds, he came across not just one-- not two-- nor three-- but a total of four strange doors to another world!
en: Out surveying his old working grounds, he came across not just one-- not two-- nor three-- but a total of four strange doors to another world!
ja: 昔の採掘場を見回っていたら、一つどころか――二つどころか――三つどころか――なんと合計四つも、別世界に続く不思議な扉を見つけたそうじゃ!

key: However, according to his report, they were all completely empty...
en: However, according to his report, they were all completely empty...
ja: だが、その者の報告によると、どれもすべて完全に空っぽだったそうでな……

key: Suspicious, isn't it?
en: Suspicious, isn't it?
ja: 怪しいと思わんかね?

key: Are you up for this one, little champion?
en: Are you up for this one, little champion?
ja: これ、やってみるかね、小さなチャンピオンよ?

key: SEACREST: Up and at 'em! That's the spirit.
en: SEACREST: Up and at 'em! That's the spirit.
ja: シークレスト: よし、いいぞ! その意気じゃ。

key: These doors were reported to be found in the deepest parts of Victory Road.
en: These doors were reported to be found in the deepest parts of Victory Road.
ja: これらの扉は、チャンピオンロードの最も深い場所で見つかったと報告されとる。

key: Surely a champion like yourself must know where that would be!
en: Surely a champion like yourself must know where that would be!
ja: あんたほどのチャンピオンなら、それがどこか、きっとわかるはずじゃ!

key: Oh? Surprising.
en: Oh? Surprising.
ja: おや? それは驚いた。

key: When you're ready then!
en: When you're ready then!
ja: じゃあ、準備ができたときにでも!

key: No point in doing anything until you're ready for it!
en: No point in doing anything until you're ready for it!
ja: 準備ができるまでは、何をしても意味がないからな!

key: SEACREST: You've got a report of a total of four Anomaly worlds hidden within the deepest parts of Victory Road!
en: SEACREST: You've got a report of a total of four Anomaly worlds hidden within the deepest parts of Victory Road!
ja: シークレスト: チャンピオンロードの最も深い場所に、合計四つのアノマリー世界が隠れているという報告が入っとる!

key: All four were empty, but something must be afoot.
en: All four were empty, but something must be afoot.
ja: 四つとも空っぽだったが、何かが起きているに違いない。

key: If anyone can figure it out, it's you.
en: If anyone can figure it out, it's you.
ja: 誰かに解き明かせるとすれば、それはあんたじゃろう。

key: Good luck, little champion!
en: Good luck, little champion!
ja: 頑張るんじゃぞ、小さなチャンピオンよ!

key: ARCHER: New sitch'.
en: ARCHER: New sitch'.
ja: アーチャー: 新しい状況だ。

key: You know that Blue Orb that you only went to incredible lengths to obtain and make sure that it wasn't stolen?
en: You know that Blue Orb that you only went to incredible lengths to obtain and make sure that it wasn't stolen?
ja: あの、あなたが並々ならぬ苦労をして手に入れ、盗まれないよう守り抜いたブルーオーブを覚えていますか?

key: Well, guess what's missing.
en: Well, guess what's missing.
ja: さて、何がなくなったかわかりますか。

key: Around the same time that was reported, a huge energy signal spiked up in Sugiline Cave.
en: Around the same time that was reported, a huge energy signal spiked up in Sugiline Cave.
ja: それが報告されたのとほぼ同時に、スギライン洞窟で巨大なエネルギー反応が急上昇しました。

key: We're hoping it's connected, and that the orb can be recovered once more, but there's no guarantee.
en: We're hoping it's connected, and that the orb can be recovered once more, but there's no guarantee.
ja: それが関連していて、オーブを再び取り戻せることを望んでいますが、保証はありません。

key: If you're good for it, it may be beneficial to check on the situation before it escalates,
en: If you're good for it, it may be beneficial to check on the situation before it escalates,
ja: 都合が良ければ、事態が悪化する前に状況を確認しておくのが有益でしょう、

key: Again.
en: Again.
ja: また、ですが。

key: MAXWELL: Heyyyy, \PN...
en: MAXWELL: Heyyyy, \PN...
ja: マクスウェル: よぉ、\PN……

key: Right... I suppose I have to be the one to tell you this...
en: Right... I suppose I have to be the one to tell you this...
ja: そうだな……これは俺が伝えなきゃいけないっぽいな……

key: So, you remember that Blue Orb you went through all that trouble to recover and keep safe before?
en: So, you remember that Blue Orb you went through all that trouble to recover and keep safe before?
ja: あの、前に大変な思いして取り戻して、安全に保管してたブルーオーブ、覚えてるか?

key: Yeeeeaaaahhh...
en: Yeeeeaaaahhh...
ja: そうなんだよなぁ……

key: It's gone again.
en: It's gone again.
ja: またなくなった。

key: No idea who, how, why, any of that--
en: No idea who, how, why, any of that--
ja: 誰が、どうやって、なんでかは全然わからねえ――

key: But we did see a huge energy spike in Sugiline Cave around the same time.
en: But we did see a huge energy spike in Sugiline Cave around the same time.
ja: でも、同じ頃にスギライン洞窟で巨大なエネルギーの急上昇を確認した。

key: With any luck, it could be connected to the Blue Orb.
en: With any luck, it could be connected to the Blue Orb.
ja: 運がよけりゃ、それがブルーオーブと関係あるかもしれねえ。

key: Your orders, should you choose to accept them:
en: Your orders, should you choose to accept them:
ja: 受けるなら、これがお前への指令だ。

key: Hike out there, check it out, and hope nothing dramatic happens.
en: Hike out there, check it out, and hope nothing dramatic happens.
ja: そこまで山道を歩いて、確認して、何もドラマチックなことが起きないよう祈る。

key: But then, what's the fun if nothing does?
en: But then, what's the fun if nothing does?
ja: まあ、何も起きなかったら、それはそれでつまんねえけどな。

key: Over to you and out.
en: Over to you and out.
ja: 以上、頼んだぜ。

key: ARCHER: Status on the Anomaly at Aegir Cave:
en: ARCHER: Status on the Anomaly at Aegir Cave:
ja: アーチャー: エイギル洞窟のアノマリーの状況報告。

key: Still waiting on a Rayquaza to be delivered there.
en: Still waiting on a Rayquaza to be delivered there.
ja: まだレックウザがそこに届けられるのを待っています。

key: Until one does, Leaders Titania and Amaria are locked in a perpetual Umbral clash against each other.
en: Until one does, Leaders Titania and Amaria are locked in a perpetual Umbral clash against each other.
ja: それが届くまで、リーダーのティタニアとアマリアは、永遠に続くアンブラルの衝突に閉じ込められています。

key: And I can't help but feel like I've heard that one before...
en: And I can't help but feel like I've heard that one before...
ja: どこかで聞いたような話だと感じずにはいられません……

key: MAXWELL: What's up, \PN!
en: MAXWELL: What's up, \PN!
ja: マクスウェル: よお、\PN!

key: Need a reminder?
en: Need a reminder?
ja: 確認いるか?

key: Those girls out at Aegir Cave are locked in an endless state of warring against each other.
en: Those girls out at Aegir Cave are locked in an endless state of warring against each other.
ja: エイギル洞窟のあの女たちは、終わりのない争いに閉じ込められてる。

key: You're gonna need to bring a Rayquaza to snap 'em out of it.
en: You're gonna need to bring a Rayquaza to snap 'em out of it.
ja: それを止めるには、レックウザを連れていく必要があるぜ。

key: You know, assuming one would just show up soon.
en: You know, assuming one would just show up soon.
ja: まあ、それがすぐに現れてくれればの話だけどな。

key: But like, if you get a spare 'Quaza and don't know what to do with it, hit me up.
en: But like, if you get a spare 'Quaza and don't know what to do with it, hit me up.
ja: でも、余ってるレックウザがいて使い道に困ってるなら、俺に声かけてくれよな。

key: I bet it'd be one wild ride on the back of one of those, y'know?
en: I bet it'd be one wild ride on the back of one of those, y'know?
ja: あの背中に乗ったら、めちゃくちゃなライドになりそうだよな、なあ?

key: Oh, hey. You must be \PN.
en: Oh, hey. You must be \PN.
ja: ああ、どうも。あなたが\PNですね。

key: I've heard about you from some of the others.
en: I've heard about you from some of the others.
ja: 他の何人かから、あなたのことは聞いています。

key: I assume you're here to help out with the influx of Legendaries?
en: I assume you're here to help out with the influx of Legendaries?
ja: 伝説ポケモンの流入への対処を手伝いに来てくれたと考えていいですか?

key: We can certainly use all the help we can get.
en: We can certainly use all the help we can get.
ja: 助けはいくらあっても足りませんから、本当に助かります。

key: Granted, things have gotten a little more stable since the doors first opened, but...
en: Granted, things have gotten a little more stable since the doors first opened, but...
ja: 最初に扉が開いた頃に比べれば、多少落ち着いてきてはいますが……

key: I'm really not looking forward to when a swarm of Kyogre flood the city.
en: I'm really not looking forward to when a swarm of Kyogre flood the city.
ja: カイオーガの群れが街に押し寄せてくるときのことを考えると、正直気が重いです。

key: Adrienn already has enough to deal with.
en: Adrienn already has enough to deal with.
ja: アドリエンヌにはもう十分すぎるほど、対応することがありますから。

key: Anyway, let me tell you about what we've got here.
en: Anyway, let me tell you about what we've got here.
ja: とにかく、こちらで扱っているものについて説明させてください。

key: I'm sure you've already noticed all the pretty colored tiles behind you.
en: I'm sure you've already noticed all the pretty colored tiles behind you.
ja: もう後ろにあるカラフルなタイルには気づいていますよね。

key: That thing is a map.
en: That thing is a map.
ja: あれは地図です。

key: When we detect an Anomaly, that map will automatically be marked in the general area where it was detected.
en: When we detect an Anomaly, that map will automatically be marked in the general area where it was detected.
ja: アノマリーを検知すると、その地図には、検知されたおおよその場所が自動的に印付けされます。

key: The map corresponds to the one on your Pokegear.
en: The map corresponds to the one on your Pokegear.
ja: その地図は、あなたのポケギアの地図と対応しています。

key: Well... mostly.
en: Well... mostly.
ja: まあ……だいたいは。

key: I don't know if you've noticed, but this region is really hard to lay out on a grid.
en: I don't know if you've noticed, but this region is really hard to lay out on a grid.
ja: 気づいているかわかりませんが、この地方は本当にグリッド状に配置するのが難しいんです。

key: That dark-ish tile near the top is supposed to represent Calcenon, Labradorra, and Route 3.
en: That dark-ish tile near the top is supposed to represent Calcenon, Labradorra, and Route 3.
ja: 一番上あたりの少し暗めのタイルは、カルセノン、ラブラドラ、3番道路を表しているつもりです。

key: We really did the best we could here.
en: We really did the best we could here.
ja: 本当に、これでも精一杯やったんですよ。

key: If you're unsure of exactly where to go, the staff around here can help point you in the right direction.
en: If you're unsure of exactly where to go, the staff around here can help point you in the right direction.
ja: どこに向かえばいいか正確にわからない場合は、ここのスタッフが正しい方向を教えてくれます。

key: It'd probably be best to check in with someone here before you investigate an anomaly, too.
en: It'd probably be best to check in with someone here before you investigate an anomaly, too.
ja: アノマリーを調査する前に、誰かに一度声をかけておくのが一番いいでしょう。

key: We don't really know what exactly to expect to find in advance- all we know is that there's something there.
en: We don't really know what exactly to expect to find in advance- all we know is that there's something there.
ja: 正直、事前に何が見つかるか正確にはわかりません――何かがそこにあるということしかわからないんです。

key: Checking in helps keep things organized here, and it means that we can send out a team for you in case you, uh, don't come back.
en: Checking in helps keep things organized here, and it means that we can send out a team for you in case you, uh, don't come back.
ja: 声をかけてもらえれば、ここの状況を整理しておけますし、万が一戻ってこなかった場合に、こちらから捜索チームを送ることもできます。

key: ...It's best to be prepared.
en: ...It's best to be prepared.
ja: ……備えあれば憂いなし、ですから。

key: Anyway, you'll see that there's a flashing marker on the map behind you.
en: Anyway, you'll see that there's a flashing marker on the map behind you.
ja: ところで、あなたの後ろの地図に、点滅しているマーカーがあるのがわかりますか。

key: That anomaly is located inside Vanhanen Castle.
en: That anomaly is located inside Vanhanen Castle.
ja: そのアノマリーはヴァンハネン城の中にあります。

key: We don't know what happened, but Serra and Noel are currently trapped inside.
en: We don't know what happened, but Serra and Noel are currently trapped inside.
ja: 何があったかはわかりませんが、セラとノエルが今、その中に閉じ込められています。

key: We don't know what happened, but Serra, Anna, and Noel are currently trapped inside.
en: We don't know what happened, but Serra, Anna, and Noel are currently trapped inside.
ja: 何があったかはわかりませんが、セラ、アンナ、ノエルが今、その中に閉じ込められています。

key: You wanna go check it out?
en: You wanna go check it out?
ja: 確認しに行きますか?

key: Great! Good luck out there.
en: Great! Good luck out there.
ja: いいですね! どうか頑張ってください。

key: I'm Cass, by the way. I'll be here if you need anything.
en: I'm Cass, by the way. I'll be here if you need anything.
ja: ちなみに、私はキャスといいます。何か必要なことがあれば、ここにいますから。

key: Mmm, okay. Let me know if you decide to later.
en: Mmm, okay. Let me know if you decide to later.
ja: ふうん、わかった。後で決めたら教えてね。

key: Hey. You ready to go?
en: Hey. You ready to go?
ja: ねえ。準備できた?

key: ...yeah, no, I think you're set.
en: ...yeah, no, I think you're set.
ja: ……うん、いや、大丈夫そうだね。

key: have fun out there.
en: have fun out there.
ja: 行ってらっしゃい。

key: ...still?
en: ...still?
ja: ……まだ?

key: I dunno what you're waiting for, but I know what the people in the castle are waiting for, and it's you.
en: I dunno what you're waiting for, but I know what the people in the castle are waiting for, and it's you.
ja: 何を待ってるのか知らないけど、あの城の中にいる人たちが何を待ってるかは知ってる。あんただよ。

key: Okay, I suppose. Everyone's still trapped in there, though.
en: Okay, I suppose. Everyone's still trapped in there, though.
ja: わかった、まあいいけど。でも、みんなまだ中に閉じ込められてるままだからね。

key: CASS: Oh, welcome back. Need a reminder?
en: CASS: Oh, welcome back. Need a reminder?
ja: キャス: あ、おかえり。確認いる?

key: CASS: There's a thing in Vanhanen Castle.
en: CASS: There's a thing in Vanhanen Castle.
ja: キャス: ヴァンハネン城で何かあったの。

key: Serra and Noel are hanging out in there.
en: Serra and Noel are hanging out in there.
ja: セラとノエルがその中でのんびりしてる。

key: ....slightly against their will.
en: ....slightly against their will.
ja: ……本人たちの意思にはほぼ反してだけどね。

key: Serra, Noel, and Anna are hanging out in there.
en: Serra, Noel, and Anna are hanging out in there.
ja: セラとノエルとアンナがその中でのんびりしてる。

key: Go swoop in and rescue them.
en: Go swoop in and rescue them.
ja: さっさと乗り込んで助け出してきて。

key: CASS: ...this again?
en: CASS: ...this again?
ja: キャス: ……またこれ?

key: You've got places to be.
en: You've got places to be.
ja: あんたも行くとこあるでしょ。

key: And, frankly, so do I.
en: And, frankly, so do I.
ja: それに、正直あたしにもあるし。

key: So I'll see you later.
en: So I'll see you later.
ja: じゃ、また後でね。

key: CASS: Oh? Well, what are you talking to me for?
en: CASS: Oh? Well, what are you talking to me for?
ja: キャス: あら? で、何であたしに話しかけてんの?

key: CASS: Oh, look, it's you.
en: CASS: Oh, look, it's you.
ja: キャス: あら、あんたか。

key: CASS: Hey! You're back.
en: CASS: Hey! You're back.
ja: キャス: あ! 戻ってきたんだ。

key: I've already heard that everything went well at the castle.
en: I've already heard that everything went well at the castle.
ja: 城の件、うまくいったってもう聞いてるよ。

key: Er... "well" is a strong word when your house merges with an alternate realm...
en: Er... "well" is a strong word when your house merges with an alternate realm...
ja: っていうか……自分の家が別次元と融合したのに「うまくいった」は言い過ぎだけど……

key: But you found everyone and took care of the anomaly.
en: But you found everyone and took care of the anomaly.
ja: でも、みんな見つけて、アノマリーも片付けたんでしょ。

key: Which, good! A LOT more have shown up while you were gone.
en: Which, good! A LOT more have shown up while you were gone.
ja: それはよかった! あんたが行ってる間に、めちゃくちゃたくさん出てきてるから。

key: Like, a lot a lot.
en: Like, a lot a lot.
ja: ほんと、めちゃくちゃたくさんね。

key: Thankfully I've gotten some help back here with managing everything.
en: Thankfully I've gotten some help back here with managing everything.
ja: ありがたいことに、こっちの管理を手伝ってくれる人が増えたよ。

key: The other attendants back here are also handing out information on anomalies.
en: The other attendants back here are also handing out information on anomalies.
ja: ここの他の受付の人たちも、アノマリーの情報を配ってるから。

key: Talk to them, too, if you haven't already!
en: Talk to them, too, if you haven't already!
ja: まだ話してないなら、その人たちにも話しかけてみて!

key: Anyway. There are birds!
en: Anyway. There are birds!
ja: それはそうと、鳥がいるんだよ!

key: There have been reports of a pretty bird, an angry bird, and a bird that is literally on fire showing up in the region.
en: There have been reports of a pretty bird, an angry bird, and a bird that is literally on fire showing up in the region.
ja: きれいな鳥、怒ってる鳥、それに文字通り燃えてる鳥が、この地方に現れたっていう報告があるの。

key: Given the whole 'legendary' situation, I'm guessing they're Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres, respectively.
en: Given the whole 'legendary' situation, I'm guessing they're Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres, respectively.
ja: 「伝説」がらみのこの状況を考えると、多分フリーザー、サンダー、ファイヤーだと思う。

key: We don't seem to be detecting any weird readings, though, so I doubt they're anomalies.
en: We don't seem to be detecting any weird readings, though, so I doubt they're anomalies.
ja: でも、特に妙な反応は検知されてないから、アノマリーではないと思うんだよね。

key: I've marked where we got the reports on the map, though.
en: I've marked where we got the reports on the map, though.
ja: 一応、報告があった場所は地図に印つけといたよ。

key: There's a report from Apophyll, a report from Ametrine, and a report from around Beryl Bridge.
en: There's a report from Apophyll, a report from Ametrine, and a report from around Beryl Bridge.
ja: アポフィルからの報告、アメトリンからの報告、それにベリル大橋あたりからの報告があるの。

key: My notes say that they're in...
en: My notes say that they're in...
ja: あたしのメモによると、その子たちがいるのは……

key: ..."Thematically-relevant locations"...
en: ..."Thematically-relevant locations"...
ja: ……「テーマ的に関連のある場所」なんだって……

key: ...Whatever that means.
en: ...Whatever that means.
ja: ……それが何を意味するかは知らないけど。

key: Go check them out!
en: Go check them out!
ja: 行って確認してきて!

key: CASS: Hi. What do you want?
en: CASS: Hi. What do you want?
ja: キャス: どうも。何の用?

key: Right. The quest.
en: Right. The quest.
ja: そうそう。クエストの件ね。

key: So originally the circus' Ringmaster was here helping out with paperwork,
en: So originally the circus' Ringmaster was here helping out with paperwork,
ja: もともとは、サーカスのリングマスターが書類仕事を手伝いにここに来てたんだけど、

key: CASS: So originally the circus' Ringmaster was here helping out with paperwork,
en: CASS: So originally the circus' Ringmaster was here helping out with paperwork,
ja: キャス: もともとは、サーカスのリングマスターが書類仕事を手伝いにここに来てたんだけど、

key: But then we got this notice and she yelled something incomprehensible, tripped up the stairs and ran away.
en: But then we got this notice and she yelled something incomprehensible, tripped up the stairs and ran away.
ja: でも、この報告が入ってきたら、意味不明なこと叫んで、階段でつまずいて、逃げてったんだよね。

key: So now I'm here again.
en: So now I'm here again.
ja: だから今、またあたしがここにいるってわけ。

key: With you.
en: With you.
ja: あんたと一緒に。

key: There's a Meloetta at the circus.
en: There's a Meloetta at the circus.
ja: サーカスにメロエッタがいるんだって。

key: I don't know if there's one of those New World portals or what, but everyone there is going apeshit over it.
en: I don't know if there's one of those New World portals or what, but everyone there is going apeshit over it.
ja: 新世界の入口があるのかどうかは知らないけど、そこの全員が大パニックになってる。

key: You gonna go check it out?
en: You gonna go check it out?
ja: 行って確認してくる?

key: CASS: Great.
en: CASS: Great.
ja: キャス: よし。

key: See you there.
en: See you there.
ja: 現地で会おうね。

key: CASS: ...What?
en: CASS: ...What?
ja: キャス: ……何。

key: All right, then get out of the way. I'm going.
en: All right, then get out of the way. I'm going.
ja: わかった、じゃあどいて。あたしが行く。

key: CASS: What?
en: CASS: What?
ja: キャス: 何。

key: I'm not gonna miss this.
en: I'm not gonna miss this.
ja: これ見逃す気ないから。

key: CASS: Bye, bitch.
en: CASS: Bye, bitch.
ja: キャス: じゃあね、クソ野郎。

key: CASS: Hi buddy.
en: CASS: Hi buddy.
ja: キャス: よお、相棒。

key: Got some more shit for you to clean up.
en: Got some more shit for you to clean up.
ja: また片付けてもらいたいクソみたいな用件があるんだけど。

key: It's in Iolia.
en: It's in Iolia.
ja: イオリアにあるやつ。

key: Off you go.
en: Off you go.
ja: じゃあ、行ってきて。

key: CASS: Oh hey, you're back.
en: CASS: Oh hey, you're back.
ja: キャス: あ、おかえり。

key: So you know how Agate was put entirely to sleep that one time?
en: So you know how Agate was put entirely to sleep that one time?
ja: アゲートがまるごと眠りにつかされたことあったの、覚えてる?

key: Well, it's happened again!
en: Well, it's happened again!
ja: それが、また起きたんだよね!

key: There's a buy-one-get-one-free sale on sleep.
en: There's a buy-one-get-one-free sale on sleep.
ja: 今回は睡眠一つ買うともう一つついてくるセールだって。

key: This one came with a free appetizer!
en: This one came with a free appetizer!
ja: 今回はおまけの前菜つきだよ!

key: Nightmares!
en: Nightmares!
ja: 悪夢のね!

key: City can't catch a break.
en: City can't catch a break.
ja: この街、ほんと休む暇ないよね。

key: On a presumably related note, another one of the tears in reality we keep sending you through has shown up on the north side of Iolia.
en: On a presumably related note, another one of the tears in reality we keep sending you through has shown up on the north side of Iolia.
ja: 多分関係あると思うんだけど、あんたをいつも通り抜けさせてる現実の裂け目が、また一つ、イオリアの北側に現れたよ。

key: Now, this isn't something I usually say, but you should really stock up and prep' yourself for this one in advance.
en: Now, this isn't something I usually say, but you should really stock up and prep' yourself for this one in advance.
ja: これ、あたし普段はあんまり言わないんだけど、今回ばかりは事前にちゃんと備えて準備しといた方がいいと思う。

key: You'll save yourself some trouble.
en: You'll save yourself some trouble.
ja: その方が面倒が減るはずだから。

key: Maybe make a back-up save or something.
en: Maybe make a back-up save or something.
ja: バックアップのセーブデータでも作っといたら?

key: You don't.

en: Whereas in the Battle Factory challenge you instead fight with a selection of randomly rented Pokémon.

key: The Battle Palace challenge is similar to the Battle Pavilion, however, there's a twist: Your Pokémon will choose their actions themselves!
en: The Battle Palace challenge is similar to the Battle Pavilion, however, there's a twist: Your Pokémon will choose their actions themselves!
ja: バトルパレスのチャレンジはバトルパビリオンに似ていますが、一つひねりがあります。ポケモンが自分で行動を選ぶのです!

key: In addition to this, random Field Effects may be optionally generated before each battle.
en: In addition to this, random Field Effects may be optionally generated before each battle.
ja: さらに、各バトルの前にランダムなフィールド効果を任意で発生させることもできます。

key: Completing a 5 battle round in either challenge with Field Effects enabled will increase your BP reward.
en: Completing a 5 battle round in either challenge with Field Effects enabled will increase your BP reward.
ja: どちらのチャレンジでも、フィールド効果を有効にした状態で5回戦を完了すると、BP報酬が増加します。

key: Would you like to enable random Field Effects?
en: Would you like to enable random Field Effects?
ja: ランダムフィールド効果を有効にしますか?

key: Random Field Effects have been enabled.
en: Random Field Effects have been enabled.
ja: ランダムフィールド効果が有効になりました。

key: Random Field Effects have been disabled.
en: Random Field Effects have been disabled.
ja: ランダムフィールド効果が無効になりました。

key: Welcome to the Battle Factory.
en: Welcome to the Battle Factory.
ja: バトルファクトリーへようこそ。

key: Would you like to fight in Singles or Doubles?
en: Would you like to fight in Singles or Doubles?
ja: シングルとダブル、どちらで戦いますか?

key: For the Battle Factory, you may choose to have one random field for the entire set, or a different random field for each battle.
en: For the Battle Factory, you may choose to have one random field for the entire set, or a different random field for each battle.
ja: バトルファクトリーでは、セット全体で一つのランダムフィールドにするか、バトルごとに異なるランダムフィールドにするか選べます。

key: Which would you like?
en: Which would you like?
ja: どちらにしますか?

key: You'll get one random field effect for the full set.
en: You'll get one random field effect for the full set.
ja: セット全体で一つのランダムフィールド効果になります。

key: You'll get one random field effect per battle.
en: You'll get one random field effect per battle.
ja: バトルごとに一つのランダムフィールド効果になります。

key: Congratulations on the win.
en: Congratulations on the win.
ja: 勝利おめでとうございます。

key: I will take your rental Pokémon back and return your own Pokémon.
en: I will take your rental Pokémon back and return your own Pokémon.
ja: レンタルしたポケモンをお返しいただき、あなた自身のポケモンをお返しします。

key: We've been waiting for you. Please come this way.
en: We've been waiting for you. Please come this way.
ja: お待ちしておりました。こちらへどうぞ。

key: ZERO: ...Hey there, \PN.
en: ZERO: ...Hey there, \PN.
ja: ゼロ: ……よう、\PN。

key: Surprised to see me out from behind the desk now?
en: Surprised to see me out from behind the desk now?
ja: カウンターの裏から出てきて驚いたか?

key: We'd finally finished cleaning up all the Anomaly reports, and, well, uhh...
en: We'd finally finished cleaning up all the Anomaly reports, and, well, uhh...
ja: アノマリー報告の片づけがようやく全部終わってさ、その、えっと……

key: Figured I'd stick around for a little bit.
en: Figured I'd stick around for a little bit.
ja: 少しの間、ここにいようと思ってな。

key: Take a little bit of time to relax.
en: Take a little bit of time to relax.
ja: ちょっと息抜きする時間を取ろうと。

key: ...You know, uh... enjoy the scenery and all.
en: ...You know, uh... enjoy the scenery and all.
ja: ……その、まあ……景色でも楽しもうかと。

key: It can be... a little overwhelming here.
en: It can be... a little overwhelming here.
ja: ここは……ちょっと圧倒される感じだけどな。

key: But whether I'm behind the counter managing reports or not...
en: But whether I'm behind the counter managing reports or not...
ja: でも、カウンターの裏で報告を管理してようとなかろうと……

key: It's been nice to see everyone back again.
en: It's been nice to see everyone back again.
ja: みんながまた戻ってきてるのを見られてうれしいよ。

key: ZERO: ...Thanks for stopping by to say hi.
en: ZERO: ...Thanks for stopping by to say hi.
ja: ゼロ: ……挨拶しに寄ってくれてありがとな。

key: It's good to see you as always, too.
en: It's good to see you as always, too.
ja: いつも通り、お前に会えてうれしいよ。

key: ZERO: Honestly, \PN, it feels all too weird now.
en: ZERO: Honestly, \PN, it feels all too weird now.
ja: ゼロ: 正直な話、\PN、今はなんだかすごく変な感じなんだ。

key: No reports to manage, no equipment to monitor, no Anomalies to help with...
en: No reports to manage, no equipment to monitor, no Anomalies to help with...
ja: 管理する報告もない、監視する機材もない、対処するアノマリーもない……

key: ...No nights losing sleep over how many we received at once sometimes, either.
en: ...No nights losing sleep over how many we received at once sometimes, either.
ja: ……一度にどれだけ受け取ったかで眠れなくなる夜もなくなった。

key: One part of me kinda thought the reports would never end.
en: One part of me kinda thought the reports would never end.
ja: 心のどこかで、報告なんて終わらないもんだと思ってたところもあった。

key: ...The other part is sad they're over and done with.
en: ...The other part is sad they're over and done with.
ja: ……もう片方は、それが終わっちまったことを寂しく思ってる。

key: ...Heh.
en: ...Heh.
ja: ……へっ。

key: I won't lie, though, it's still been nice to be able to rest at the end of it all.
en: I won't lie, though, it's still been nice to be able to rest at the end of it all.
ja: でもうそはつかないぜ、全部終わって休めるようになったのは、やっぱりうれしいことだった。

key: Seeing everyone here...
en: Seeing everyone here...
ja: ここでみんなに会えて……

key: Ace, Blake... Cal--
en: Ace, Blake... Cal--
ja: エース、ブレイク……キャル――

key: Ace, Taka--
en: Ace, Taka--
ja: エース、タカ――

key: Eve and Lumi, too...
en: Eve and Lumi, too...
ja: イヴとルミも……

key: ...I, uh... I missed them.
en: ...I, uh... I missed them.
ja: ……その、俺は……みんなに会いたかったんだ。

key: Maybe I could try and talk with them sometime, too.
en: Maybe I could try and talk with them sometime, too.
ja: 今度、みんなとも話してみようかな。

key: ...Dunno if they'd want to, but...
en: ...Dunno if they'd want to, but...
ja: ……向こうがそう思ってくれるかはわからないけど……

key: Might be nice.
en: Might be nice.
ja: いいかもな。

key: ZERO: You know, \PN, I've been thinking.
en: ZERO: You know, \PN, I've been thinking.
ja: ゼロ: なあ、\PN、ずっと考えてたんだ。

key: I kinda want to see if there's other places where I can try and help out, too.
en: I kinda want to see if there's other places where I can try and help out, too.
ja: 俺が手伝えそうな場所が、他にもないか探してみたいなって。

key: Between helping manage the Anomaly reports, and that, uh, freezing New World expedition together...
en: Between helping manage the Anomaly reports, and that, uh, freezing New World expedition together...
ja: アノマリー報告の管理を手伝ったり、あの、その……凍える新世界の探検を一緒にやったりして……

key: It was... a lot to manage.
en: It was... a lot to manage.
ja: ……対応するのは、色々大変だった。

key: But it just... felt right.
en: But it just... felt right.
ja: でも、それがなんか……正しいことだって感じたんだ。

key: To finally be able to do something right myself.
en: To finally be able to do something right myself.
ja: ようやく自分で何か正しいことができたって。

key: Being able to support you there, and support behind the counter here...
en: Being able to support you there, and support behind the counter here...
ja: あそこでお前を支えたり、ここでカウンターの裏から支えたり……

key: ZERO: ...Y'know, \PN...
en: ZERO: ...Y'know, \PN...
ja: ゼロ: ……なあ、\PN……

key: All that time behind the desk got me thinking.
en: All that time behind the desk got me thinking.
ja: デスクの裏で過ごしてた間、色々考えたんだ。

key: Kinda want to see if there's some other places where I can try and help out, too.
en: Kinda want to see if there's some other places where I can try and help out, too.
ja: 俺が手伝えそうな場所が、他にもないか探してみたいなって。

key: Helping manage all of those Anomaly reports...
en: Helping manage all of those Anomaly reports...
ja: あのアノマリー報告を全部管理する手伝いをして……

key: It just... felt right.
en: It just... felt right.
ja: それがなんか……正しいことだって感じたんだ。

key: If we could all do the little things within our power to help the people around us, then maybe things wouldn't be so bad.
en: If we could all do the little things within our power to help the people around us, then maybe things wouldn't be so bad.
ja: みんなが、自分の力でできる小さなことで周りの人を助けられれば、そんなに悪い状況にもならないんじゃないかって。

key: ...U-uh, sorry to lay that on you suddenly.
en: ...U-uh, sorry to lay that on you suddenly.
ja: ……あ、いや、急にこんな話して悪いな。

key: You know, again.
en: You know, again.
ja: また、その、こんな感じで。

key: Thanks for hearing me out, though.
en: Thanks for hearing me out, though.
ja: でも、聞いてくれてありがとな。

key: ZERO: Heh, guess I've gotta figure out what else to do nowadays, huh.
en: ZERO: Heh, guess I've gotta figure out what else to do nowadays, huh.
ja: ゼロ: へっ、これからは他に何をするか、考えなきゃな。

key: It's uh, weird to not have anything to do.
en: It's uh, weird to not have anything to do.
ja: その、何もすることがないってのも変な感じだ。

key: ...Don't have to tell me twice how much I've been blabbering about it.
en: ...Don't have to tell me twice how much I've been blabbering about it.
ja: ……こんなにこの話ばっかしてるって、わざわざ言わなくてもわかってるよ。

key: I'm just glad that there's even been something that someone like me could do for this whole clusterfuck.
en: I'm just glad that there's even been something that someone like me could do for this whole clusterfuck.
ja: ただ、俺みたいなやつでも、このめちゃくちゃな状況で何かできることがあったってのは、素直にうれしいんだ。

key: ZERO: ...Uh.
en: ZERO: ...Uh.
ja: ゼロ: ……あー。

key: "Someone like me" is only rude to myself, I guess.
en: "Someone like me" is only rude to myself, I guess.
ja: 「俺みたいなやつ」なんて、自分に対して失礼なだけだよな。

key: This is... embarrassing, but sometimes it still helps me to think of myself as if I were still different people.
en: This is... embarrassing, but sometimes it still helps me to think of myself as if I were still different people.
ja: これは……恥ずかしい話だけど、今でも時々、自分がまだ複数の人格だったみたいに考えると楽になることがあるんだ。

key: I wouldn't want to talk like that to Eve and Lumi.
en: I wouldn't want to talk like that to Eve and Lumi.
ja: イヴやルミに、そんな風には言いたくない。

key: I know they wouldn't say that to me.
en: I know they wouldn't say that to me.
ja: あいつらだって、俺にそんなこと言わないってわかってるし。

key: So, uh... to correct it...
en: So, uh... to correct it...
ja: だから、その……言い直すと……

key: I'm proud that I could still make a difference here.
en: I'm proud that I could still make a difference here.
ja: ここで、俺が変化を起こせたことを誇りに思ってる。

key: Help around with fighting the good fight.
en: Help around with fighting the good fight.
ja: 正しい戦いを手伝えたってことをな。

key: ZERO: I'm glad you stopped by for a chat over here.
en: ZERO: I'm glad you stopped by for a chat over here.
ja: ゼロ: こっちに寄って話してくれてうれしいよ。

key: ...Maybe I'll join everyone sometime.
en: ...Maybe I'll join everyone sometime.
ja: ……いつかみんなに加わろうかな。

key: ZERO: Need any kind of support today?
en: ZERO: Need any kind of support today?
ja: ゼロ: 今日は何か手伝いが必要か?

key: ...Or were you just saying hi?
en: ...Or were you just saying hi?
ja: ……それとも、ただ挨拶しに来ただけか?

key: ZERO: It can be kind of disorienting here sometimes.
en: ZERO: It can be kind of disorienting here sometimes.
ja: ゼロ: ここは時々、なんだか落ち着かない感じがするな。

key: Not that I mind, though.
en: Not that I mind, though.
ja: 別に嫌ってわけじゃないけど。

key: Good music, people who... still tolerate me? Friends?
en: Good music, people who... still tolerate me? Friends?
ja: いい音楽に、俺のことを……まだ我慢してくれる人たち? 友達?

key: It's nice.
en: It's nice.
ja: いいもんだな。

key: What's up, champ?
en: What's up, champ?
ja: 調子はどうだ、チャンプ?

key: You into remixing at all?
en: You into remixing at all?
ja: リミックスには興味あるか?

key: Whether it's music or Pokémon, it can really help to shake it up!
en: Whether it's music or Pokémon, it can really help to shake it up!
ja: 音楽だろうがポケモンだろうが、たまには変えてみるのもいいもんだぜ!

key: For instance, say you wanna swap out a move or two on your squad for one battle, but you wanna get it back later...
en: For instance, say you wanna swap out a move or two on your squad for one battle, but you wanna get it back later...
ja: 例えば、あるバトルのために技を一つ二つ入れ替えたいけど、後で元に戻したいってときあるだろ……

key: I can help you out there!
en: I can help you out there!
ja: そういうときに力になれるぜ!

key: See, all you gotta do?
en: See, all you gotta do?
ja: やることは簡単さ。

key: Bring me a Pokémon, and I'll memorize its moves as they are.
en: Bring me a Pokémon, and I'll memorize its moves as they are.
ja: ポケモンを連れてきてくれれば、今の技をそのまま覚えとくよ。

key: We save that mix, and you can come back to it any time you want.
en: We save that mix, and you can come back to it any time you want.
ja: そのミックスを保存しといて、いつでも戻ってこれるようにするんだ。

key: No charge, for the champ.
en: No charge, for the champ.
ja: チャンプには無料でな。

key: What do you say, wanna give it a shot?
en: What do you say, wanna give it a shot?
ja: どうだ、試してみるか?

key: Here to mix it up, champ?
en: Here to mix it up, champ?
ja: ミックスしに来たか、チャンプ?

key: What are you thinkin'?
en: What are you thinkin'?
ja: 何を考えてる?

key: Pick a moveset to record.
en: Pick a moveset to record.
ja: 記録する技構成を選んでくれ。

key: Changed your mind?
en: Changed your mind?
ja: 気が変わったか?

key: All right, I'll memorize that Pokémon's moves.
en: All right, I'll memorize that Pokémon's moves.
ja: よし、そのポケモンの技を覚えとくぜ。

key: What should we call this mix?
en: What should we call this mix?
ja: このミックス、何て呼ぶ?

key: You already saved a moveset under the name \v[6].
en: You already saved a moveset under the name \v[6].
ja: もう\v[6]って名前で技構成を保存してあるぞ。

key: How do you wanna deal with this, champ?
en: How do you wanna deal with this, champ?
ja: これ、どうしたい、チャンプ?

key: Got it. \v[6] has been updated.
en: Got it. \v[6] has been updated.
ja: わかった。\v[6]を更新したぜ。

key: Got it. It's saved as \v[6]
en: Got it. It's saved as \v[6]
ja: わかった。\v[6]として保存したぜ

key: Hey, we gotta call it something, don't we?
en: Hey, we gotta call it something, don't we?
ja: なあ、何か名前つけなきゃだろ?

key: It's more fun that way.
en: It's more fun that way.
ja: その方が楽しいしな。

key: And if it's not something, it's nothing.
en: And if it's not something, it's nothing.
ja: 何かじゃないなら、それは何もないってことだ。

key: You don't wanna make your Pokémon remember nothing, champ, trust me.
en: You don't wanna make your Pokémon remember nothing, champ, trust me.
ja: ポケモンに「何も」覚えさせたくはないだろ、チャンプ、信じてくれ。

key: That Pokémon's moves are already saved under the name \v[6].
en: That Pokémon's moves are already saved under the name \v[6].
ja: そのポケモンの技は、もう\v[6]って名前で保存済みだ。

key: Let's run it back!
en: Let's run it back!
ja: もう一回いこうぜ!

key: What are we doin', champ?
en: What are we doin', champ?
ja: 何をする、チャンプ?

key: Well, you get the gist of how it goes, yeah?
en: Well, you get the gist of how it goes, yeah?
ja: まあ、だいたいの流れはわかってるよな?

key: Talk to me any time you need.
en: Talk to me any time you need.
ja: 用があればいつでも話しかけてくれ。

key: Oh, by the way, there's a switch to the left of me to turn down the lights if they're getting obnoxious for you.
en: Oh, by the way, there's a switch to the left of me to turn down the lights if they're getting obnoxious for you.
ja: ああ、そうだ、照明がうるさいって感じたら、俺の左にあるスイッチで弱められるぞ。

key: Keep it cool, champ.
en: Keep it cool, champ.
ja: クールにいこうぜ、チャンプ。

key: NIHIL: I wondered if I'd see you around here.
en: NIHIL: I wondered if I'd see you around here.
ja: ニヒル: ここで会うかもとは思ってたぜ。

key: They got me on security detail.
en: They got me on security detail.
ja: 警備につかされてんだ。

key: Just stand watch, and toss out the loud people.
en: Just stand watch, and toss out the loud people.
ja: ただ見張って、うるさい奴を追い出すだけ。

key: Doesn't happen often.
en: Doesn't happen often.
ja: そんなに頻繁にはないけどな。

key: Good vibes.
en: Good vibes.
ja: 悪くない雰囲気だ。

key: You sure this qualifies as "honest work"?
en: You sure this qualifies as "honest work"?
ja: これって本当に「まっとうな仕事」って言えるのかよ?

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: まあいいや。

key: I mean, thanks.
en: I mean, thanks.
ja: てか、ありがとな。

key: I mean... whatever.
en: I mean... whatever.
ja: てか……まあいいや。

key: NIHIL: I already got in trouble for socializing too much on the clock though, so I'm gonna have to skip on the small talk.
en: NIHIL: I already got in trouble for socializing too much on the clock though, so I'm gonna have to skip on the small talk.
ja: ニヒル: もう勤務中にしゃべりすぎて怒られたから、雑談は勘弁してくれ。

key: Don't mind me, bigshot, just do your thing.
en: Don't mind me, bigshot, just do your thing.
ja: 気にすんな、大物さん、勝手にやってくれ。

key: NIHIL: What's up.
en: NIHIL: What's up.
ja: ニヒル: よう。

key: Welcome to the Battle Palace!
en: Welcome to the Battle Palace!
ja: バトルパレスへようこそ!

key: Is this your first time here? If you're unaware, the Battle Palace is much like the standard Battle Pavilion, except your Pokémon will fight on their own!
en: Is this your first time here? If you're unaware, the Battle Palace is much like the standard Battle Pavilion, except your Pokémon will fight on their own!
ja: 初めてのご利用ですか? ご存じない方のために説明しますと、バトルパレスは通常のバトルパビリオンとよく似ていますが、あなたのポケモンが自分の判断で戦う点が違います!

key: I know we don't have the most... stellar... of reputations...
en: I know we don't have the most... stellar... of reputations...
ja: あまり……華々しい……評判ではないと承知していますが……

key: But I assure you, Trainer, our Battle Palace experience is much-improved over that of other regions!
en: But I assure you, Trainer, our Battle Palace experience is much-improved over that of other regions!
ja: でもご安心ください、トレーナーさん、私たちのバトルパレスは他地方のものよりずっと改善されています!

key: Unlike a certain someone's Palace in a certain tropical region, in our Palace, Pokémon can actually fight at their full potential!
en: Unlike a certain someone's Palace in a certain tropical region, in our Palace, Pokémon can actually fight at their full potential!
ja: とある熱帯地方の、とある人物のパレスとは違い、私たちのパレスではポケモンが本来の力を発揮して戦うことができます!

key: I'm not sure if the Pokémon in Reborn are smarter or what, but here, they'll actually fight kinda competently! No more indecision or bad moves!
en: I'm not sure if the Pokémon in Reborn are smarter or what, but here, they'll actually fight kinda competently! No more indecision or bad moves!
ja: リボーンのポケモンが賢いのかどうかはわかりませんが、ここではきちんと戦ってくれます! 迷ったり下手な技を選んだりはしません!

key: And, here, they even know when to return to their Poké Ball and let their teammates do the fighting!
en: And, here, they even know when to return to their Poké Ball and let their teammates do the fighting!
ja: しかもここでは、モンスターボールに戻って仲間に戦いを任せるタイミングまでわかっているんです!

key: You don't have to do anything! So, that said...
en: You don't have to do anything! So, that said...
ja: あなたは何もしなくていいんです! というわけで……

key: Sorry, you can't participate... You need three different Pokémon to enter.
en: Sorry, you can't participate... You need three different Pokémon to enter.
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、参加できません……参加には異なる3匹のポケモンが必要です。

key: Please choose the three Pokémon that will enter!
en: Please choose the three Pokémon that will enter!
ja: 参加させる3匹のポケモンを選んでください!

key: Sorry, you can't participate... You need four different Pokémon to enter.
en: Sorry, you can't participate... You need four different Pokémon to enter.
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、参加できません……参加には異なる4匹のポケモンが必要です。

key: Please choose the four Pokémon that will enter!
en: Please choose the four Pokémon that will enter!
ja: 参加させる4匹のポケモンを選んでください!

key: Have a great day, and I hope you consider stopping by again!
en: Have a great day, and I hope you consider stopping by again!
ja: 良い一日を、そしてまたのお越しをお待ちしております!

key: Your total is now \v[593]!
en: Your total is now \v[593]!
ja: 現在の合計は\v[593]です!

key: Your record has been updated!
en: Your record has been updated!
ja: 記録が更新されました!

key: I hope you enjoyed your time at the Battle Palace!
en: I hope you enjoyed your time at the Battle Palace!
ja: バトルパレスでの時間を楽しんでいただけたなら幸いです!

key: If you enjoyed the experience so much that you're thinking 'Oh my god, dear Palace attendant, how can I enjoy this wonderful experience more?', well...
en: If you enjoyed the experience so much that you're thinking 'Oh my god, dear Palace attendant, how can I enjoy this wonderful experience more?', well...
ja: もし「ああ、パレス係の人、この素晴らしい体験をもっと楽しむにはどうしたらいいの?」と思うほど気に入っていただけたなら……

key: You could try telling someone "battlepalace"! Then, you won't have to lift a finger to order your Pokémon around ever again!
en: You could try telling someone "battlepalace"! Then, you won't have to lift a finger to order your Pokémon around ever again!
ja: 誰かに「battlepalace」と言ってみてください! そうすれば、二度とポケモンに指図する手間をかけずに済みますよ!

key: Thanks for playing!
en: Thanks for playing!
ja: ご参加ありがとうございました!
